articles.titleCn: 面向端到端多语言隐喻处理：整合检测、翻译与评估
articles.abstractCn: 隐喻语言仍然是多语言自然语言处理的一个主要挑战，因为成功的解释和翻译需要超越字面词汇意义的推理。现有研究主要将隐喻检测、机器翻译和翻译评估作为独立任务进行探索，而很少研究如何将这些组件整合到一个统一的计算框架中。本博士研究计划旨在开发一个用于多语言隐喻处理端到端框架，包含三个互补的研究方向：（1）跨语言的鲁棒隐喻检测，（2）面向隐喻的翻译评估，用于人类评估和自动质量估计，（3）将隐喻检测与翻译评估相结合的联合建模。该研究将结合语言学理论与大型语言模型最新进展，开发新的数据集、标注方法、评估基准和隐喻感知机器翻译的自动评估方法。预期成果是一个统一框架，能够提升多语言NLP系统在处理比喻语言时的开发与评估能力。

articles.title: SIGNPOST-Bench: Benchmarking Text-Vision Conflict Resolution in Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) make grounded predictions in real-world scenes by combining visual and textual cues, yet existing benchmarks rarely reveal how they arbitrate between these evidence sources when they conflict. We introduce SIGNPOST-Bench, a controlled counterfactual benchmark for evaluating text-vision conflict resolution. Each source image is transformed into a counterfactual quintuplet of Original, Blank, Similar, Random, and Adversarial variants. Synthetic, localized scene-text interventions are designed to preserve non-textual content, enabling paired measurements of changes in localization performance and directed shifts toward geographic targets introduced by conflicting text. SIGNPOST-Bench contains 5,111 counterfactual groups and 25,555 image variants from four datasets. We evaluate 20 MLLMs from seven providers. Compared with Original images, Adversarial variants raise median localization error from 282 km to 1,347 km, a 4.8-fold increase. Among geocodable adversarial samples, 6.5-20.1% of predictions lie less than 50 km from the injected target across models, and every evaluated model exhibits a positive mean paired reduction in target distance from Blank to Adversarial. Compatible, unrelated, and conflicting text replacements produce distinct effects on model predictions, while clean-input localization performance does not fully predict robustness to conflicting text. These results establish visual geolocation as a continuous diagnostic of scene-text arbitration and provide a controlled framework for evaluating how MLLMs resolve conflicting multimodal evidence.
articles.titleCn: SIGNPOST-Bench：多模态大型语言模型中文本-视觉冲突解决基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）通过结合视觉和文本线索，在现实场景中进行基于证据的预测，然而现有的基准测试很少揭示它们在证据来源冲突时如何进行权衡。我们引入了SIGNPOST-Bench，这是一个用于评估文本-视觉冲突解决的控制性反事实基准。每个源图像被转化为一个包含原始（Original）、空白（Blank）、相似（Similar）、随机（Random）和对抗（Adversarial）变体的反事实五元组。设计了一种合成、局部的场景-文本干预，以保留非文本内容，从而能够对定位性能的变化和由冲突文本引入的地理目标方向的定向变化进行配对测量。SIGNPOST-Bench包含5,111个反事实组以及来自四个数据集的25,555个图像变体。我们评估了来自七个供应商的20个MLLMs。与原始图像相比，对抗变体将中位数定位误差从282公里增加到1,347公里，增加了4.8倍。在可地理编码的对抗样本中，不同模型中6.5-20.1%的预测距离注入目标点不到50公里，并且所有评估模型在空白到对抗的配对测量中均表现出目标距离的均值正向减少。兼容、不相关和冲突的文本替换对模型预测产生不同的效果，而干净输入的定位性能并不能完全预测对冲突文本的鲁棒性。这些结果将视觉地理定位确立为场景-文本权衡的连续诊断指标，并提供了一个控制性框架，用于评估MLLMs如何解决冲突的多模态证据。

articles.title: Hallucinations on the Board: Tool-Augmented Evaluation of LLM Chess Commentary
articles.abstract: Superhuman game engines in domains like chess have made expert-level evaluations easily accessible, yet they communicate what is true without the natural-language explanations that make such expertise educationally useful to experts and non-experts alike. Large language models could, in principle, bridge this gap, but they frequently hallucinate due to limited domain-specific knowledge, and standard reference-based or LLM-as-a-judge frameworks cannot reliably detect these errors. In this work, we present ACT-Eval, an evaluation framework that decomposes chess commentary into atomic claims and routes them to engine-supported tools and expert-annotated gold references to assess factual correctness, conceptual coverage, and move-quality judgment. We release a benchmark of 325 position--move pairs spanning pedagogical, tournament, and critical positions, including 125 positions with expert-verified gold atoms and a five-class error taxonomy. Evaluating leading proprietary and open-weight models, we find that factual hallucinations remain pervasive in chess commentary: GPT-5.4 without tools produces incorrect sub-claims 22.0% of the time, while smaller open-weight models exceed 40%. Although tool augmentation substantially improves factual correctness and move-quality assessment, coverage of expert strategic and tactical ideas remains limited across all models. Human calibration shows that ACT-Eval's factual judgments fall within the observed range of inter-human agreement, while its coverage scores correlate strongly with human assessments of strategic completeness.
articles.titleCn: 棋盘上的幻觉：工具增强的大型语言模型棋局评论评估
articles.abstractCn: 在象棋等领域，超人类游戏引擎使得专家级评估变得触手可及，然而它们在传达真相时缺乏自然语言解释，而这些解释对于专家和非专家都具有教育意义。理论上，大型语言模型可以弥合这一差距，但由于领域特定知识的局限性，它们经常产生幻觉。标准的基于参考或将LLM作为裁判的框架无法可靠地检测这些错误。在这项工作中，我们提出了ACT-Eval，一个将象棋评论分解为原子声明，并将其路由到引擎支持的工具和专家标注的黄金参考，以评估事实正确性、概念覆盖范围和移动质量判断的评价框架。我们发布了一个包含325个位置-移动对的基准，涵盖教学、比赛和关键位置，其中包括125个具有专家验证的黄金原子和五类错误分类。评估领先的专有和开放权重模型后，我们发现事实性幻觉在象棋评论中仍然普遍存在：GPT-5.4在不使用工具的情况下，22.0%的时间会产生错误的子声明，而较小的开放权重模型超过40%。尽管工具增强显著提高了事实正确性和移动质量评估，但所有模型在专家战略和战术思想覆盖范围上仍然有限。人类校准表明，ACT-Eval的事实判断落在观察到的跨人类协议范围内，而其覆盖评分与人类对战略完整性的评估高度相关。

articles.title: Patients-like-me: A Variational LM--GNN Framework for Explainable Clinical Prediction
articles.abstract: Language models (LMs) offer strong textual representations for electronic health records (EHRs), but they encode patient sequences in isolation and provide limited explainability. Graph neural networks (GNNs) complement LMs by incorporating inter-patient relationships and enabling reference-patient attribution, yet they rely on high-quality patient representations. We propose Patients-like-me (PLM), a unified LM--GNN framework that integrates local patient semantics with global cohort structure. To train PLM efficiently, we introduce a Variational Expectation-Maximization algorithm that alternates LM and GNN updates under a supervised variational objective. Extensive experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV show that PLM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with improvements generalizing across encoder-only and decoder-only LM backbones. These gains are achieved with only modest additional computational overhead. PLM also provides reference-patient explanations by retrieving influential similar patients, while edge-masking experiments confirm that the highest-ranked references have the greatest impact on model predictions.
articles.titleCn: 患者如我：一种用于可解释临床预测的变分LM-GNN框架
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型（LMs）为电子健康记录（EHRs）提供了强大的文本表征，但它们孤立地编码患者序列，且可解释性有限。图神经网络（GNNs）通过整合患者间关系并实现参考患者归因来补充LMs，但它们依赖于高质量的患者表征。我们提出了Patients-like-me（PLM），一个统一的LM-GNN框架，将局部患者语义与全局队列结构相结合。为高效训练PLM，我们引入了一种变分期望最大化算法，该算法在监督变分目标下交替进行LM和GNN更新。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上的大量实验表明，PLM始终优于现有最佳方法，且改进效果可推广至仅编码器或仅解码器的LM骨干网络。这些增益仅需适度的额外计算开销。PLM通过检索有影响力的相似患者提供参考患者解释，而边掩码实验证实，排名最高的参考对模型预测的影响最大。

articles.title: Behavioral Skill Reconstruction: Reconstructing Hidden Functionality from LLM Agent Skills
articles.abstract: Closed source agent skills may encode proprietary instructions, scripts, constants, and data. Providers may offer their capabilities as services while keeping the underlying packages hidden. Prior work focuses on prompt injection attacks that directly disclose these artifacts, and existing defenses accordingly aim to prevent such leakage. However, preventing file disclosure does not prevent users from recovering the functionality those files implement. This raises a fundamental question: can a user reconstruct a skill's functionality through ordinary use while its files remain hidden? We study behavioral skill reconstruction (BSR), in which an attacker uses valid task requests and observed responses to build a functional clone of a hidden skill. We introduce SkillClone, a black-box attack that clones a target skill by forming an interface hypothesis from its public advertisement, issuing structured benign probes, synthesizing an executable replica, and iteratively repairing it through differential validation against the victim skill. Across 30 skills spanning rules, tables, procedures, and algorithms, SkillClone achieves exact or partial recovery on held-out inputs for several targets. Iterative requerying closes gaps missed by single-round reconstruction. Because SkillClone uses only legitimate interactions, disclosure-focused defenses provide limited coverage, and less detailed skill descriptions offer limited protection. These results show that file secrecy alone does not ensure functional secrecy. Defenses must also limit cumulative information leakage from ordinary use.
articles.titleCn: 行为技能重构：从大型语言模型代理技能中重构隐藏功能
articles.abstractCn: 闭源代理技能可能编码专有指令、脚本、常量和数据。提供者可能将其功能作为服务提供，同时隐藏底层包。以往的研究集中于直接泄露这些工件的提示注入攻击，现有的防御措施相应地旨在防止此类泄露。然而，阻止文件泄露并不能阻止用户恢复这些文件实现的功能。这提出了一个基本问题：当其文件保持隐藏时，用户能否通过常规使用重建技能的功能？我们研究了行为技能重建（BSR），其中攻击者使用有效的任务请求和观察到的响应来构建一个隐藏技能的功能性克隆。我们引入了SkillClone，这是一种黑盒攻击，通过从其公开宣传中形成接口假设来克隆目标技能，发出结构化的良性探测，合成可执行副本，并通过与受害者技能的差异验证迭代修复它。在涵盖规则、表格、程序和算法的30个技能中，SkillClone对几个目标在保留输入上实现了精确或部分恢复。迭代重新查询弥补了单轮重建遗漏的差距。由于SkillClone仅使用合法交互，专注于泄露的防御措施提供有限的覆盖范围，而较详细的技能描述提供有限的保护。这些结果表明，文件保密性本身并不能确保功能保密性。防御措施还必须限制从常规使用中累积的信息泄露。

articles.title: Large Language Models for Low-Resource Languages: A Conceptual Framework for an Electronic Explanatory Dictionary of the Tajik Language
articles.abstract: This paper presents a conceptual framework for developing an electronic explanatory dictionary of the Tajik language using large language models (LLMs). The relevance of the work stems from the absence of a comprehensive digital lexicographic resource for Tajik that is comparable in functionality to dictionaries for high-resource languages, and from the limited adaptation of modern natural language processing technologies to low-resource language systems. Based on a systematic survey of existing linguistic, statistical, and corpus resources, we propose a dictionary architecture that integrates modules for morphological analysis, lemmatization, semantic clustering, and dictionary entry generation using LLMs. The choice of subword tokenization is justified by the agglutinative nature of Tajik morphology and its high morphological variability, along with a parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) strategy suitable for limited annotated data. The novelty of the work lies in proposing the first holistic conceptual architecture of an explanatory dictionary for Tajik that unifies classical lexicographic methods, language statistics, and generative capabilities of LLMs into a single system. The practical significance of the study is the formation of a methodological foundation for developing a full-featured electronic dictionary that can serve both as a lexicographic tool and as a core resource for machine translation, automatic summarization, sentiment analysis, and other applied NLP tasks. The paper is intended for specialists in computational linguistics, lexicography, and developers of natural language processing systems working with low-resource languages.
articles.titleCn: 面向低资源语言的巨型语言模型：塔吉克语电子释义词典的概念框架
articles.abstractCn: 本文提出了一种基于大型语言模型（LLMs）开发塔吉克语电子解释词典的概念框架。该研究的意义在于塔吉克语缺乏功能上可与高资源语言词典相媲美的综合性数字词汇资源，以及现代自然语言处理技术在低资源语言系统中的有限应用。基于对现有语言、统计和语料库资源的系统调查，我们提出了一个集成词形分析、词元提取、语义聚类和LLMs驱动的词典条目生成的词典架构。选择子词分词方法是基于塔吉克语形态的黏着性及其高度形态变化，并结合适用于有限标注数据的参数高效微调（PEFT）策略。本研究的创新之处在于首次提出了一种整合传统词汇学方法、语言统计和LLMs生成能力的塔吉克语解释词典的整体概念架构。该研究的实践意义在于为开发功能全面的电子词典奠定了方法论基础，该词典既可作为词汇学工具，也可作为机器翻译、自动摘要、情感分析等应用NLP任务的核心资源。本文面向计算语言学、词汇学以及从事低资源语言自然语言处理系统开发的专家。

articles.title: Test, then Route: How Language Models Execute In-Context Conditional Rules Across Models and Languages
articles.abstract: When a language model follows an in-context conditional rule such as "if P(x) then A else B," does it assemble a runtime circuit with one module that tests the predicate and another that routes the answer? We probe this with activation patching under a four-donor design whose two swapped-rule donors make the condition and the answer word disagree, so each layer reveals which of the two it carries. Across three open models from two families and six languages sharing one fixed item bank, a mid-stack residual band carries the predicate's truth value: patching it reroutes the answer with predicate-outcome flip near 1.0 and mapping flip near 0.0, meeting a strict pre-specified isolation criterion in 17 of 18 cells, and the same localization holds across five predicate families. The router shows the opposite profile. A learned subspace flips A and B near-perfectly within the trained pair yet transfers to a new pair at approximately 0 in every model, while in Gemma-3-4B (the only model probed cross-lingually) it transfers at approximately 0.98 to the same pair in other languages. Under every probe we ran, the router direction is token-bound and non-transferable (largely answer-readout in Gemma, pair-specific in Qwen) rather than an abstract routing module. Test is modular; under these probes, route is not.
articles.titleCn: 测试，然后路由：语言模型如何跨模型和语言执行情境条件规则
articles.abstractCn: 当一个语言模型遵循“如果P(x)则A否则B”的上下文条件规则时，它是否通过一个测试谓词的模块和一个路由答案的模块来组装运行时电路？我们通过激活修补法在一个四供体设计中探究了这一点，其中两个交换规则的供体使得条件和答案词不一致，因此每一层都揭示了它携带的是哪一个。在两个家族的三个开源模型和六种共享一个固定项目库的语言中，一个中间堆栈残差带携带了谓词的真值：修补它会导致答案与谓词结果翻转接近1.0，而映射翻转接近0.0，在18个单元中的17个单元中满足严格预定义的隔离标准，并且这种定位在五个谓词家族中保持一致。路由器显示出相反的模式。一个学习的子空间在训练对内几乎完美地翻转A和B，但在每个模型中转移到新对时接近0，而在Gemma-3-4B（唯一被跨语言测试的模型）中，它转移到其他语言中的相同对时接近0.98。在所有我们运行的测试中，路由方向是词元相关的且不可迁移（在Gemma中主要是答案读取，在Qwen中是特定对），而不是抽象路由模块。测试是模块化的；在这些测试下，路由不是。

articles.title: Visualizing Graph-to-Answer Mechanism Recovery in Materials-Science Hypothesis Generation
articles.abstract: AI co-scientists can generate fluent materials-science hypotheses, but fluency does not show that an answer preserves a scientifically meaningful mechanism. We present a graph-to-answer mechanism-tracing case study for Graph-PRefLexOR-8B, a Qwen3-8B model adapted to expose distinct stages for brainstorming, graph construction, pattern extraction, and synthesis. We organize semantic backtracking, graph corruption, activation-based recovery measurements, and layer-by-token-region grids into a visual diagnostic workflow for inspecting this pathway. Across 100 open-ended materials-science questions, final answers remain closest to the model's own structured stages, especially synthesis. Under graph corruption, a full sweep over 37 residual-stream checkpoints, the embedding output and 36 transformer blocks, shows little mechanism recovery in the earlier transition region at layers 7--10, recovery instead concentrates in late synthesis and answer-start regions around layers 30 and 36. The workflow is intended to help scientists and model developers identify where a generated hypothesis loses or regains mechanism support before it is passed to downstream experimental planning.
articles.titleCn: 在材料科学假设生成中可视化图到答案机制恢复
articles.abstractCn: AI协科学家能够生成流畅的材料科学假设，但流畅性并不表明答案保留了科学上有意义的机制。我们针对Graph-PRefLexOR-8B（一个为揭示头脑风暴、图构建、模式提取和综合等不同阶段而适配的Qwen3-8B模型）进行了一个图到答案的机制追踪案例研究。我们将语义回溯、图损坏、基于激活的恢复测量和逐层逐标记区域网格组织成一个可视化诊断工作流程，用于检查这一路径。在100个开放式材料科学问题中，最终答案最接近模型自身的结构化阶段，尤其是综合阶段。在图损坏情况下，对37个残差流检查点（即嵌入输出和36个Transformer块）进行完整扫描，显示在层7至10的早期转换区域几乎没有机制恢复，恢复反而集中在层30和36周围的后期综合和答案起始区域。该工作流程旨在帮助科学家和模型开发者识别在生成假设传递给下游实验规划之前，其机制支持是丢失还是恢复的位置。

articles.title: Mind the Cap: Output-Budget Regimes Change the Measured Multilingual Reasoning Gap
articles.abstract: Multilingual evaluations report accuracy at a single output-token cap, but languages need different numbers of tokens to express the same content, so the cap is a hidden experimental variable. We test whether the native-vs-translate gap on MGSM (German, Thai, Swahili) is a token-budget artifact for Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct under four prompting strategies. The measured gap swings by up to 57 points across budgets, length normalization moves it by up to 38.9 points where the cap binds, and at tight caps normalization can reverse which strategy scores higher. We prospectively froze the sweep's three Qwen peaks and its near-zero value at 1024 and evaluated them on 540,000 independently hard-capped decodes: a second frozen family of six Holm-corrected tests rejects every null. The frozen test at $B^*=1024$ still fails to reject because native accuracy has already saturated there; above saturation, the residual difference is a strategy-performance gap, not an identified reasoning deficit. The same truncation channel prices a cost-ordered adaptation ladder: a cross-fitted Thai vocabulary extension closes 0.0 points of the gap at the frozen budget and 4.9 points where 19% of traces still truncate. A third frozen family varies only the announced budget at a fixed enforced cap; announcing 128 rather than 2048 tokens moves Thai native accuracy by 5.1 points, so accuracy is not a function of the enforced cap alone. A correct-emission timing identity computed from one long-cap run matches the three pre-specified MGSM peaks to 0.65 points and, in an exploratory Qwen-only analysis of three further benchmarks, tracks held-out items to 0.92 points, locating the peak exactly in five of seven cells. Treat the output cap as an independent variable and report accuracy across the budget regime, not at a single budget.
articles.titleCn: 注意上限：产出预算制度改变了测量的多语言推理差距
articles.abstractCn: 多语言评估报告在单个输出标记上限下的准确率，但不同语言需要不同数量的标记来表达相同内容，因此上限是一个隐藏的实验变量。我们测试了在四种提示策略下，Qwen3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct在MGSM（德语、泰语、斯瓦希里语）上的母语与翻译差距是否是标记预算的伪影。测量的差距在预算范围内波动高达57分，长度归一化在受上限约束时将其移动高达38.9分，在严格的上限下归一化可以逆转哪种策略得分更高。我们前瞻性地冻结了扫描中的三个Qwen峰值及其在1024处的接近零值，并在540,000个独立硬上限解码上评估它们：一个冻结的六Holm校正测试系列否定了所有零假设。在$B^*=1024$的冻结测试仍然无法拒绝，因为母语准确率在此处已经饱和；饱和以上，残余差异是策略性能差距，而不是已识别的推理缺陷。相同的截断通道为成本排序的适应阶梯定价：一个跨拟合的泰语词汇扩展在冻结预算下缩小了0.0分的差距，在19%的轨迹仍然截断时缩小了4.9分。第三个冻结系列仅改变宣布的预算，在固定的强制上限下；宣布128而不是2048个标记将泰语母语准确率移动了5.1分，因此准确率不是仅由强制上限决定的。从一次长上限运行中计算的正确发射时间身份与预先指定的三个MGSM峰值匹配到0.65分，并在对三个进一步基准的Qwen仅探索性分析中跟踪保留项目到0.92分，在七个单元格中的五个中精确地定位了峰值。将输出上限视为自变量，并在预算范围内报告准确率，而不是在单个预算下。

articles.title: Neighborhood-Aware Dual Biomedical Entity Linking
articles.abstract: Biomedical entity linking grounds mentions in clinical and scientific text to entities in a curated knowledge base (KB) with ontological structure, which supports downstream applications such as literature-scale information extraction and patient-record normalization. The task has several challenges at once: the KB contains large numbers of entities, mentions are often ambiguous, and gold labels follow annotation conventions specific to each corpus. To address these challenges, we propose PILOT, a three-stage framework made up of neighborhood-aware retrieval, dual reranking, and score fusion. The retriever injects ontological structure from both the query and KB side, by reformulating mentions and pooling entity embeddings. The retrieved pool is then scored from two complementary views, one over surface forms and one over context, and fused together. PILOT achieves the state of the art on average across five widely-used benchmarks and remains efficient at inference.
articles.titleCn: 基于邻域感知的双向生物医学实体链接
articles.abstractCn: 生物医学实体链接将临床和科学文本中的提及与具有本体结构的精选知识库（KB）中的实体进行关联，支持下游应用，如文献规模的信息提取和患者记录标准化。这项任务同时面临几个挑战：知识库包含大量实体，提及通常具有歧义性，且金标签遵循特定于每个语料库的标注规范。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了PILOT，这是一个由邻域感知检索、双重重排序和分数融合组成的三个阶段框架。检索器通过重新表述提及和池化实体嵌入，从查询和知识库两侧注入本体结构。检索到的池被从两个互补的视角进行评分，一个基于表面形式，一个基于上下文，然后融合在一起。PILOT在五个广泛使用的基准测试中平均达到了当前最佳水平，并且在推理时仍保持高效。

articles.title: GEB-Bench: Abstract Structures Told in Many Voices
articles.abstract: Can a model look at a river delta and a lightning bolt and see that they share a structure? We introduce GEB-Bench, a benchmark whose unit is an abstract structural motif--self-reference, a strange loop, a Mobius twist--in the spirit of Godel, Escher, Bach. Each motif is told in several voices: a natural scene whose composition is the structure, a folk story whose telling enacts it through a mechanically checkable form device, a mathematical theorem, and a programmatic skeleton; surface parameters are declared nuisance variables and never scored. Motifs, voices, and the structural changes between them form a small cross-modal category, and GEB-Bench's tasks are its questions. Evaluating twelve open and proprietary models, we find that abstraction failure is lawful. The central finding is a gap between recognition and cross-voice mapping: models identify a structure within one voice far better than they carry it across voices; every model pays this tax, and mapping strong enough to narrow it appears only at the frontier tier. Two patterns support it. Errors align more strongly with the designed formal geometry than with measured perceptual geometries, and frontier models from different vendors converge on the same wrong answers; and surface complexity taxes every model that reads structure, with capacity buying headroom rather than immunity. GEB-Bench is fully generative and released with its pipeline.
articles.titleCn: GEB-Bench：多声之述的抽象结构
articles.abstractCn: 一个模型能否观察到一个河三角洲和一道闪电，并认识到它们具有相同的结构？我们介绍了GEB-Bench，这是一个以抽象结构动机——自指、怪圈、莫比乌斯扭曲——为单位的基准测试，灵感来源于哥德尔、埃舍尔、巴赫。每个动机都通过多种声音呈现：一个自然场景，其构图就是结构；一个民间故事，通过机械可验证的形式装置来讲述它；一个数学定理；以及一个程序化骨架；表面参数被声明为干扰变量，从未被评分。动机、声音以及它们之间的结构变化构成一个小型跨模态类别，而GEB-Bench的任务就是它的疑问。评估了十二个开源和专有模型后，我们发现抽象失败是符合规律的。核心发现是识别与跨声音映射之间的差距：模型在一个声音内部识别结构远比跨声音传递结构要好；每个模型都为此付出代价，而足以缩小这一差距的映射仅在边界层级出现。两种模式支持这一发现。错误与设计好的形式几何比与测量的感知几何更一致，来自不同供应商的边界模型会聚到相同的错误答案；表面复杂性消耗了所有读取结构的模型，容量购买的是空间而非免疫力。GEB-Bench是完全生成式的，并随其流程一起发布。

articles.title: FinPerMA: A Theory-Informed, Event-Grounded Personalized-Memory Benchmark for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as personalized assistants in high-stakes domains such as financial advising, yet it remains unclear whether they can maintain and update an individualized user model over long horizons. Existing personalized-memory benchmarks primarily test factual retention or rely on weakly constrained model-generated trajectories, leaving event-driven preference adaptation underexplored. We introduce FinPerMA, an event-grounded benchmark that evaluates personalized memory against frozen longitudinal investor trajectories. Its generation pipeline combines deterministic, theory-informed impact rules, controlled LLM narration, and automated quality screening; a Post-Shock checkpoint isolates whether an agent has integrated a material event into its persistent user model. On 2,994 questions from 276 personas, seven frontier LLMs and up to seven memory configurations remain far from saturated: no full-context configuration exceeds approximately 0.47 overall accuracy or approximately 39% on multiple-choice questions. Attribution analysis shows that summary-based memory often preserves factual details while losing the preference signals needed for personalization; simple retrieval can therefore outperform purpose-built memory systems, with the gap widening after shocks.
articles.titleCn: FinPerMA：一种基于理论指导、事件感知的个性化记忆基准，用于大型语言模型代理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地被用作高风险领域的个性化助手，例如金融咨询，但它们是否能在长期内维持和更新个性化的用户模型仍不明确。现有的个性化记忆基准主要测试事实性记忆保持或依赖弱约束的模型生成轨迹，导致事件驱动的偏好适应研究不足。我们引入FinPerMA，这是一个基于事件的基准，用于评估个性化记忆在冻结的纵向投资者轨迹上的表现。其生成流程结合了基于理论的确定性影响规则、受控的LLM叙述和自动化质量筛选；一个冲击后检查点用于判断代理是否已将其整合到持久用户模型中的重大事件。在来自276个角色的2994个问题中，七种前沿LLM和高达七种记忆配置仍远未饱和：没有全上下文配置的整体准确率超过约0.47，多项选择题上的准确率超过约39%。归因分析表明，基于摘要的记忆通常保留事实细节，但丢失了个性化所需的偏好信号；因此，简单检索可以优于专门构建的记忆系统，冲击后差距会扩大。

articles.title: SpecDrop: Parameter-Free Category-Conditioned Routing for Modular Specialization
articles.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) networks pursue specialization through learned routers, gates, and load-balancing losses, yet at matched total-parameter budgets learned routers can underperform equal-weight No-Routing baselines. Is the bottleneck the routing algorithm, or the alignment between training-signal granularity and the target categories? We probe the question with SpecDrop, a fixed parameter-free routing scheme: each of $K$ branches receives weight $p_a$ for its assigned category and a small leakage $p_i > 0$ otherwise, merged through a category-independent fixed denominator, with no learned routing parameters and no auxiliary losses; the category label is required at inference. On vision tasks where each image has one superclass label (CIFAR-100 on ResNet-110; ImageNet-1K on ViT-S/16), SpecDrop reaches 79.23% on CIFAR-100 and 79.89% on ImageNet-1K, exceeding parameter-matched baselines that do not use the label (+4.75 over dense on CIFAR-100; +6.53 over the No-Routing+SE control on ImageNet-1K). These gains quantify what category supervision buys when deployed through routing -- not an advantage over label-aware deployments of the baselines: given the same label, masking a dense model's outputs is stronger for accuracy alone (85.2 / 83.7). SpecDrop's contribution is converting the label into trained-in modular structure: 58%/100% branch-category alignment, and masking gains of 0.00 (CIFAR) / +1.06 (ImageNet) -- the output-space restriction is largely internalized during training. On fuzzy partitions, where training units span multiple categories (SlimPajama-6B language modeling with a 30M Transformer; SuperNI instruction tuning over Llama-3.2-1B with LoRA), the routing mechanism reduces to the matched No-Routing controls within seed noise, the null our thesis predicts. Granularity alignment, not algorithm choice, localizes when routing helps. Code: https://github.com/Beryex/SpecDrop
articles.titleCn: SpecDrop：无参数类别条件路由的模块化专业化
articles.abstractCn: 专家混合（MoE）网络通过学习路由器、门控和负载均衡损失来实现专业化，但在匹配的总参数预算下，学习路由器可能不如等权无路由基线表现好。瓶颈是路由算法，还是训练信号粒度与目标类别之间的对齐？我们通过SpecDrop来探究这个问题，SpecDrop是一种无固定参数的路由方案：每个K个分支为其分配的类别接收权重$ p_a $，其他情况下接收一个小的泄漏$ p_i > 0 $，通过类别无关的固定分母合并，没有学习路由参数，也没有辅助损失；推理时需要类别标签。在图像任务中每个图像有一个超类标签（CIFAR-100在ResNet-110上；ImageNet-1K在ViT-S/16上），SpecDrop在CIFAR-100上达到79.23%，在ImageNet-1K上达到79.89%，超过了参数匹配且不使用标签的基线（在CIFAR-100上比密集模型高4.75；在ImageNet-1K上比No-Routing+SE控制高6.53）。这些增益量化了通过路由部署类别监督带来的好处——不是相对于基线标签感知部署的优势：给定相同标签，屏蔽密集模型的输出在单独的精度上更强（85.2 / 83.7）。SpecDrop的贡献是将标签转换为训练中的模块化结构：58%/100%的分支-类别对齐，以及屏蔽增益0.00（CIFAR）/ +1.06（ImageNet）——输出空间的限制在训练过程中很大程度上被内化。在模糊分区中，训练单元跨越多个类别（SlimPajama-6B语言建模使用30M Transformer；SuperNI指令微调Llama-3.2-1B使用LoRA），路由机制简化为种子噪声内的匹配无路由控制，这验证了我们假设的空值。粒度对齐，而非算法选择，决定了路由何时有帮助。代码：https://github.com/Beryex/SpecDrop

articles.title: FinProBench: Evaluating Financial AI Agents with Role-Grounded Rubrics Derived from Professional Deliverables
articles.abstract: Evaluating financial AI agents requires criteria aligned with real professional work. Existing rubric methods typically derive criteria from task prompts or model outputs, overlooking tacit standards visible only in practitioner deliverables. We introduce FinProBench, a benchmark for professional financial tasks, and Role-Grounded Rubric Construction (RGRC), a reusable pipeline that derives rubrics from deliverables produced by practitioners in the same role. RGRC comprises four stages: Deliverable Collection, Competency Extraction, Rubric Synthesis, and Validation. Its rubrics capture tacit standards, distinguish quality levels, and transfer across tasks within a role. Before analysis, we classified 57 occupations by deliverable genre into 30 prior-rich conventional roles and 27 prior-sparse role-specialized roles. Across all roles, Prompt-only nearly matches RGRC for conventional roles (89.2% vs. 90.7%), but RGRC substantially outperforms it for role-specialized roles (99.1% vs. 78.0%). This split indicates that prompt engineering can approximate rubrics when conventions are well represented in model priors, while professional grounding is essential for standards beyond those priors. FinProBench is built from 1,723 curated deliverables spanning 57 occupations, 8 financial sub-industries, and 161 deliverable types, and releases an initial evaluation set of 20 complete tasks covering 20 roles in 7 sub-industries. With heterogeneous LLM judges and role-level rubrics, human deliverables rank first on average (73.7 vs. 70.3, 70.2, and 69.6 out of 100), while all four systems show overlapping 95% confidence intervals and complementary strengths. Reusing rubrics at the role level reduces estimated per-task construction effort by 6.7 times relative to authoring each rubric from scratch.
articles.titleCn: FinProBench：基于专业交付成果的角色基础评分标准评估金融AI代理
articles.abstractCn: 评估金融AI代理需要与实际专业工作相一致的评判标准。现有的评分标准方法通常从任务提示或模型输出中提取标准，而忽略了只有从业者交付成果中才能显现的隐性标准。我们引入了FinProBench，这是一个用于专业金融任务的基准，以及基于角色的评分标准构建（RGRC），这是一个可重复使用的管道，从同一角色从业者产生的交付成果中推导评分标准。RGRC包含四个阶段：交付成果收集、能力提取、评分标准合成和验证。其评分标准捕捉隐性标准，区分质量等级，并在同一角色内的任务间进行迁移。在分析前，我们将57个职业按交付成果类型分为30个先验丰富的传统角色和27个先验稀疏的角色专业化角色。在所有角色中，仅提示几乎与RGRC对传统角色相同（89.2% vs. 90.7%），但对于角色专业化角色，RGRC大幅优于仅提示（99.1% vs. 78.0%）。这种差异表明，当模型先验中很好地代表了惯例时，提示工程可以近似评分标准，而专业基础对于超越先验标准的规范至关重要。FinProBench由1,723个经过策划的交付成果构建，涵盖57个职业、8个金融子行业和161种交付成果类型，并发布了一个初始评估集，包含20个完整的任务，覆盖7个子行业的20个角色。使用异构LLM裁判和角色级评分标准，人类交付成果平均排名第一（73.7 vs. 70.3、70.2和69.6，满分100），而所有四个系统显示出重叠的95%置信区间和互补的优势。在角色级别重用评分标准，相对于从头开始编写每个评分标准，将估计的每项任务构建工作量减少了6.7倍。

articles.title: ParVL: Parallel Scaling and Expandable Compute Allocation for Multimodal LLMs
articles.abstract: Existing scaling strategies for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) typically expand either model parameters or sequential inference computation, incurring substantial memory or latency overhead. More importantly, most existing methods fail to alter the rigid, fixed computation allocation between the Vision Transformer and the Large Language Model components, limiting task-specific optimization. To address this, we introduce the Parallel Vision-Language (ParVL) scaling framework for MLLMs, which scales parallel computation by reusing the existing ViT and LLM backbone parameters across multiple vision and language branches. This framework raises a central question: given a fixed backbone parameter budget, how should additional shared-backbone computation be allocated between the vision and language modalities? We instantiate each parallel computational stream with branch-specific prefix parameters over a shared backbone, and train the entire model end-to-end via full-parameter supervised fine-tuning on roughly 13B tokens. We systematically study the computation-allocation trade-off between the ViT encoder and LLM decoder. ParVL improves overall multimodal performance over same-recipe single-branch baselines, and the best evaluated vision--language allocation varies across tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/YangYangGirl/ParVL.
articles.titleCn: ParVL：多模态大语言模型的并行扩展与可扩展计算分配
articles.abstractCn: 现有的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）扩展策略通常通过扩展模型参数或顺序推理计算来提升性能，但这会带来巨大的内存或延迟开销。更重要的是，大多数现有方法未能改变视觉Transformer与大语言模型组件之间僵化的固定计算分配，从而限制了针对特定任务的优化。为解决这一问题，我们引入了并行视觉-语言（ParVL）扩展框架，该框架通过在多个视觉和语言分支中复用现有的ViT和LLM主干参数来扩展并行计算。该框架提出了一个核心问题：在固定的主干参数预算下，应如何将额外的共享主干计算在视觉和语言模态之间进行分配？我们对每个并行计算流使用分支特定的前缀参数在共享主干上进行实例化，并通过在全参数监督微调下对约130亿个token进行端到端训练。我们系统地研究了ViT编码器和LLM解码器之间的计算分配权衡。ParVL在相同配置的单分支基线之上提升了整体多模态性能，并且最佳的视觉-语言分配因任务而异。代码可在https://github.com/YangYangGirl/ParVL获取。

articles.title: SocietyBench: Forecasting Counterfactual Social-World Evolution
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs), and the agents built on top of them, are now benchmarked heavily on whether they can finish a task -- fix a bug, drive a browser, operate a GUI. A complementary social ability, namely how well a model understands and forecasts the way real social events unfold, has barely been measured. We introduce SocietyBench, an end-to-end benchmark that takes a one-line event topic, collects Web news and social-media posts across five platforms, distills them into a date-indexed timeline that keeps factual events and a public-opinion layer separate, and then turns every cutoff date on that timeline into an audited bank of forecasting questions. Questions are scored on two orthogonal 100-point axes: probability calibration and temporal accuracy. Before any model sees a timeline, a three-phase procedure replaces every named entity and shifts every date by a per-event constant, turning a real arc into a counterfactual social world -- structurally identical to what happened, but stripped of the surface labels a model could match against pre-training memory. On five heterogeneous events and 125 prediction points in Chinese and English editions, the strongest of six frontier LLMs reaches only 75.0 out of 100, against a trivial anchor of 50. The two axes come apart: a model can be calibration-strong but time-weak, or the reverse. Three agent frameworks built on a shared base model fail to improve on that base, and two model-free heuristics trail every LLM. Per-event gaps reach 21.4 points on a single axis, which is our main argument for evaluating on several events rather than one. All anonymized timelines, question banks, ground truth, and scoring code are released.
articles.titleCn: SocietyBench：预测反事实社会世界演变
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）及其构建的智能体现在在能否完成任务方面进行了大量基准测试——修复错误、驾驶浏览器、操作图形用户界面。一个补充性的社交能力，即模型理解和预测真实社会事件发展方式的能力，几乎未被衡量。我们介绍了SocietyBench，这是一个端到端的基准测试，它以单行事件主题为输入，收集五个平台上的网络新闻和社交媒体帖子，将其提炼为日期索引的时间线，将事实事件和公众意见层分开，然后将时间线上的每个截止日期转化为经过审核的预测问题库。问题在两个正交的100分轴上评分：概率校准和时序准确性。在模型看到时间线之前，通过一个三阶段程序替换每个命名实体并将每个日期按事件常数偏移，将真实事件弧转化为反事实的社交世界——在结构上与实际发生的情况相同，但去除了模型可能在预训练记忆中匹配的表面标签。在五个异构事件和125个中文和英文预测点上，六个前沿LLM中最强的也只能达到75.0分，而一个简单的基准锚点为50分。两个轴是分离的：模型可以是校准强但时间弱，反之亦然。基于共享基础模型的三个智能体框架未能改进基础模型的表现，而两个无模型的启发式方法落后于每个LLM。单个轴上的每事件差距达到21.4分，这是我们主张在多个事件而非单个事件上评估的主要论点。所有匿名化时间线、问题库、真实答案和评分代码均已发布。

articles.title: WorldCup Arena: Prospective, Leakage-Free Evaluation of Frontier LLMs on a Live Tournament
articles.abstract: Benchmarks that measure the forecasting ability of large language models are almost always retrospective: the event has happened, the answer is somewhere on the Web, and the evaluation must defend itself against memorisation. We report the opposite design. Over the 39 days of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, six frontier LLMs -- all with extended thinking and native server-side web search -- were asked before every kickoff, one match at a time, to fill in a seven-market prediction card for all 104 matches, plus 12 group winners and a pre-tournament outright pool; no answer existed when the question was asked, so the evaluation is leakage-free by construction rather than by filtering, and the frozen archive holds 4,494 scored predictions. What the tournament establishes is a set of behaviours the six systems share. On match outcome they average 63.9%, level with backing the bookmaker's favourite -- which is in fact what they usually do. They agree with one another far more often than they are right, so a majority vote adds nothing. They under-commit to draws and to goals, and crowd their scoreline picks onto a single prototypical result. Accuracy tracks how lopsided a fixture is rather than how much is known about it: it collapses in the closest ties, where the dossiers are richest, while questions about the tournament as a whole are answered well. On this task the current generation of frontier systems is not sharply differentiated: the standings hold up at the top and the bottom across the run and churn in the middle, and the margins stay narrow throughout. The briefing dossiers, fixtures and official results are released as a benchmark, together with the scoring code.
articles.titleCn: 世界杯竞技场：在实时赛事中对前沿大型语言模型进行无泄漏的前景评估
articles.abstractCn: 衡量大型语言模型预测能力的基准测试几乎总是回顾性的：事件已经发生，答案可以在网络上找到，评估必须防御记忆效应。我们报告了相反的设计。在2026年FIFA世界杯的39天期间，六种前沿大型语言模型——所有模型都具有扩展性思考和原生服务器端网络搜索功能——在每场比赛开始前被要求逐一填写104场比赛的七市场预测卡，外加12个小组冠军和赛前整体投注池；提问时没有答案存在，因此评估在结构上是无泄露的，而不是通过过滤实现的，冻结的档案包含4,494个得分预测。该赛事建立了一组六个系统共享的行为模式。在比赛结果上，它们的平均准确率为63.9%，与支持博彩公司最喜欢的投注相当——这实际上是他们通常的做法。它们彼此之间同意得远比正确得多，因此多数投票毫无意义。它们对平局和进球的承诺不足，并将它们的比分预测挤到单一典型结果上。准确率反映的是比赛的偏斜程度，而不是对其了解的程度：在比分最接近的比赛（即资料最丰富的比赛）中准确率崩溃，而关于整个赛事的问题则回答得很好。在这个任务上，当前一代前沿系统没有显著差异：排名在运行期间保持在顶部和底部，中间则出现轮换，而差距始终很窄。简报资料、赛程和官方结果被作为基准发布，连同评分代码。

articles.title: TurnSight: Turn-Level Hindsight Self-Distillation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning
articles.abstract: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) enables LLMs to solve complex tasks through iterative tool interactions. However, existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on trajectory-level supervision, limiting fine-grained credit assignment in long-horizon TIR scenarios. On-policy self-distillation offers denser signals through teacher branches with privileged context, but existing approaches typically derive such context from ground-truth answers or retrieved skills, which may not reflect the states actually visited by the agent. Moreover, token-level supervision fails to capture the turn-level structure of tool interactions. To address this, we propose TurnSight, a turn-level hindsight self-distillation framework that derives supervision directly from execution-conditioned hindsight. It then constructs multiple hindsight views with different lookahead horizons and selects reliable supervision through cross-horizon directional agreement. Finally, the selected hindsight signal is normalized across sibling rollouts and used to adaptively modulate RL advantages while preserving their original optimization direction. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of TurnSight. Our codes are available at https://github.com/quchangle1/TurnSight.
articles.titleCn: TurnSight：基于转向级别的回顾式自我蒸馏技术，用于工具集成推理
articles.abstractCn: 工具集成推理（TIR）使大型语言模型能够通过迭代工具交互解决复杂任务。然而，现有的强化学习方法通常依赖于轨迹级别的监督，这在长时程TIR场景中限制了细粒度的信用分配。在线自我蒸馏通过具有特权上下文的教师分支提供更密集的信号，但现有方法通常从真实答案或检索到的技能中推导此类上下文，这可能无法反映代理实际访问的状态。此外，标记级别的监督无法捕捉工具交互的回合级结构。为此，我们提出了TurnSight，这是一个回合级别的后见之明自我蒸馏框架，它直接从执行条件后的见推导监督。然后，它构建具有不同前瞻时程的多个后见之明视图，并通过跨时程方向一致性选择可靠的监督。最后，所选的后见之明信号在兄弟回滚中归一化，并用于自适应地调节RL优势，同时保留其原始优化方向。在三个基准测试上的大量实验证明了TurnSight的有效性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/quchangle1/TurnSight获取。

articles.title: PAST-Bench: Benchmarking the Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement in Personal Agents
articles.abstract: Recursive self-improvement requires agents to turn accumulated experience into better future behavior. Personal AI agents offer a concrete setting for studying this capability because they retain preferences, task histories, tool routines, and learned skills across sessions. Yet whether retained experience actually improves them over time has not been systematically tested. We introduce PAST-Bench, a benchmark designed to isolate this question. Each agent runs through ordered sequences of fresh-session tasks under matched conditions that turn retained experience on and off. It spans 26 scenarios and 204 episodes across memory, procedural reuse, information gathering, and update. We report both later-task gains and whether those gains follow the intended save, retrieve, and update pathway. Across seven base models and four agent frameworks, improvement is real but uneven across capabilities. Agents with the same headline gain can differ markedly in whether that gain is supported by evidence of the intended pathway. Guided by these findings, we develop Hermes+, which extends Hermes with five targeted interventions across stages of the agent loop. Hermes+ raises the average gain from retained experience and provides clearer pathway evidence, with its strongest improvement on tasks requiring outdated state to be replaced, although the effect remains capability- and model-dependent. Together, PAST-Bench and Hermes+ provide an evaluation and diagnostic foundation for studying how persistent agents can progress from retaining experience to systematically improving through it. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/PAST-Bench
articles.titleCn: PAST-Bench：评估个人智能体递归自我改进基础
articles.abstractCn: 递归自我改进要求智能体将积累的经验转化为更好的未来行为。个人AI智能体提供了一个具体的环境来研究这种能力，因为它们能在会话间保留偏好、任务历史、工具流程和所学技能。然而，保留的经验是否确实随着时间的推移使它们得到改进，尚未得到系统的检验。我们介绍了PAST-Bench，这是一个旨在分离这个问题的基准。每个智能体在匹配条件下运行一系列新会话任务，这些条件会开启和关闭保留的经验。它涵盖了记忆、程序重用、信息收集和更新等26个场景和204个片段。我们报告了后期任务的收益以及这些收益是否遵循了预期的保存、检索和更新路径。在七个基础模型和四个智能体框架中，改进是真实的，但在不同能力上存在不均衡。具有相同主要收益的智能体，在收益是否得到预期路径证据的支持上可能存在显著差异。根据这些发现，我们开发了Hermes+，它在智能体循环的阶段扩展了Hermes的五个针对性干预措施。Hermes+提高了平均收益，并提供了更清晰的路径证据，其最大改进体现在需要替换过时状态的任务上，尽管效果仍然取决于能力和模型。PAST-Bench和Hermes+共同为研究持久智能体如何从保留经验到通过它进行系统改进提供了评估和诊断的基础。代码：https://github.com/Gen-Verse/PAST-Bench

articles.title: Agogic: Performance-Timed Music Tokens for LLM-Native Text-to-Symbolic-Music Generation
articles.abstract: Text-to-music language models begin with a choice usually made by default: how to tokenize music. Normally entangled with backbone, data, and recipe, its effect has never been measured in isolation. We fix pretrained Qwen3.5 (0.8B-27B), data, budget, and decoding, and swap only the representation across seven tokenizations, anchoring texture metrics to each representation's model-free ceiling. The ordering is clean and surprising: representation, not model size, is the binding variable for distributional fidelity. Scaling the backbone 34x barely moves Frechet Music Distance (FMD), whereas switching representation halves it. PMT, a performance-resolution stream we release (10 ms timing, per-note velocity, multi-track texture; 609 symbols), reaches FMD 159 at 0.8B against 272-286 for beat grids (1.7-1.8x lower, up to 2.8x elsewhere; non-overlapping bootstrap CIs), so a 0.8B performance-resolution model beats a 27B beat grid. It reappears on a 26M from-scratch backbone and a second performance-resolution tokenizer: a property of the class, not one lucky vocabulary. Nor is it a finer-lattice artifact: snapping PMT's onsets to the beat grids' resolution still leaves it 67-129 FMD ahead of both (n=500). The effect is distributional; whether it is audible is a separate question, left open by our probe, with a human study pre-registered. Native caption adherence is weak but separable: a lightweight decode-time constraint doubles instrument-F1 (.28 to .60) and Correct-Key (.16 to .35) at no distributional cost. We release the harness, 25+ checkpoints, two corpora (86.6k aligned across caption/MIDI/ABC/audio; 6.25M captioned, the largest for music), and an imprinting diagnostic: published text-to-MIDI systems reproduce their training distribution near-invariant to the caption (72% vs. 71% chord-time on disjoint domains). The field's next representation claim can now be measured, not asserted.
articles.titleCn: Agogic：面向大型语言模型的、基于性能的音乐符号生成文本转换音乐标记
articles.abstractCn: 文本到音乐的模型通常以一个默认选择开始：如何对音乐进行分词。这个选择通常与模型架构、数据集和训练方法紧密相关，但其独立效果从未被测量过。我们固定了预训练的Qwen3.5（0.8B-27B）模型、数据集、预算和解码方法，仅在七种不同的分词方式之间切换表示，并将纹理指标锚定在每个表示的无模型限制的上限。顺序清晰且令人惊讶：表示方式，而非模型大小，是分布保真度的关键变量。将模型架构扩展34倍几乎未改变Frechet音乐距离（FMD），而切换表示方式则将其减半。我们发布了一种性能-分辨率流PMT（10毫秒计时、每音符速度、多轨纹理；609个符号），在0.8B规模下达到FMD 159，而节拍网格的FMD为272-286（降低了1.7-1.8倍，其他方面最高可降低2.8倍；非重叠引导置信区间），因此0.8B的性能-分辨率模型优于27B的节拍网格。它再次出现在一个从零开始的26M模型架构和第二个性能-分辨率分词器上：这是该类别的特性，而非偶然的词汇。这也不是更细粒度网格的产物：将PMT的起音对齐到节拍网格的分辨率后，它仍然比两者分别领先67-129 FMD（n=500）。这种效应是分布性的；它是否可听是一个独立的问题，我们的探测实验将其留白，并已预先注册了人类研究。原生标题的遵循性较弱但可分离：一个轻量级的解码时约束条件将乐器F1（从0.28提高到0.60）和正确调性（从0.16提高到0.35）翻倍，且不增加分布成本。我们发布了该工具、25+个检查点、两个语料库（在标题/MIDI/ABC/音频上对齐了86.6k个数据；6.25M个带标题数据，是音乐领域最大的）、以及一个印记诊断：已发表的文本到MIDI系统在训练分布上对标题的再现几乎是恒定的（在分离域上为72% vs. 71%的和弦时间）。现在，该领域的下一个表示声明可以被测量，而非断言。

articles.title: OneDayAgent: Towards a Long-Horizon Harness for Autonomous Agents
articles.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly applied to open-ended everyday requests that span work, study, and life. These tasks are long-horizon, cross-environment, and multimodal, forcing the agent to preserve goals and constraints across many steps while navigating heterogeneous tools and attachments. While prior work has addressed individual failure modes such as goals drift, states loss, and context overflow, whether a single harness can manage them jointly and remain effective across backends has received less study. We present OneDayAgent, a long-horizon harness for autonomous agents. OneDayAgent turns an open-ended request into a managed execution process that decomposes tasks into bounded subtasks, maintains execution memory under context pressure, and verifies and repairs the final deliverable. We evaluate OneDayAgent on AgentIF-OneDay across 104 tasks. With the GLM-5.2 backend, OneDayAgent sets a new state of the art with an overall score of 0.821. The same harness runs across five backend LLMs from three model families, indicating the harness generalizes across backends without tuning, even as different models induce distinct execution styles under the same workflow.
articles.titleCn: OneDayAgent：面向自主代理的长时程利用
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理正越来越多地应用于涵盖工作、学习和生活的开放式日常请求。这些任务具有长时程、跨环境、多模态的特点，迫使代理在导航异构工具和附件时，跨越多个步骤保存目标和约束。尽管已有研究解决了诸如目标漂移、状态丢失和上下文溢出等单个失效模式，但单一框架能否联合管理这些模式并在不同后端保持有效性，却较少得到研究。我们提出了OneDayAgent，一种用于自主代理的长时程框架。OneDayAgent将开放式请求转化为受管理的执行过程，将任务分解为有界子任务，在上下文压力下维持执行内存，并验证和修复最终交付成果。我们在AgentIF-OneDay上对OneDayAgent进行了104项任务的评估。使用GLM-5.2后端时，OneDayAgent以0.821的综合得分创下了新的最优水平。该框架在来自三个模型系列的五种后端LLM上运行，表明其无需调优即可跨后端泛化，即使不同模型在相同工作流程下会引发不同的执行风格。

articles.title: When Attention Goes Blind: Numerical Failure in ALiBi Positional Encodings
articles.abstract: We identify a previously overlooked failure mode of ALiBi positional encoding: its linear bias scaling underflows floating-point precision, which zeroes out a large fraction of attention weights and renders the affected attention heads partially blind. We analyze this failure mode, characterize its impact, and examine four mitigation strategies. We further demonstrate its occurrence in state-of-the-art pretrained models based on ALiBi. Comprehensive pretraining experiments with 148M-parameter decoder models help us to disentangle its effects from out-of-context degradation. We find that ALiBi's failure mode can substantially impair token retrieval while having only a minor effect on standard decoder benchmarks. We propose four training-time mitigation strategies and evaluate them individually and in combinations, finding that log-scaled distances yield the most consistent improvements in passkey retrieval. Despite this problem, default ALiBi slopes remain a surprisingly strong baseline, particularly for needle-in-a-haystack retrieval. Based on these findings we provide concrete recommendations on how to train models with ALiBi.
articles.titleCn: 当注意力变得盲目：ALiBi位置编码中的数值失效
articles.abstractCn: 我们识别出ALiBi位置编码中一个先前被忽视的失效模式：其线性偏差缩放在浮点精度下溢出，导致大量注意力权重归零，并使受影响的注意力头部分别失明。我们分析了这种失效模式，描述了其影响，并考察了四种缓解策略。我们进一步证明了该失效模式在基于ALiBi的当前最先进预训练模型中确实存在。通过使用148M参数的解码器模型进行的全面预训练实验，我们成功将其影响与无上下文退化区分开来。我们发现ALiBi的失效模式会显著损害token检索，但在标准解码器基准测试中影响甚微。我们提出了四种训练时缓解策略，并分别和组合评估了它们，发现对数缩放距离在passkey检索中能带来最一致性的改进。尽管存在这个问题，默认的ALiBi斜率仍然是一个出人意料的强基线，尤其是在针找干草堆检索任务中。基于这些发现，我们提供了具体的建议，说明如何使用ALiBi训练模型。

articles.title: string2string Studio: An Interactive, In-Browser Platform for String-to-String Algorithms
articles.abstract: We present string2string Studio, an interactive in-browser platform for string-to-string analysis across natural language processing, computational biology, and the digital humanities. The system integrates six main modules (alignment, distance, similarity, search, generation metrics, and BLAST homology search), operating at character, word, token, line, and residue levels. Its C++-based algorithms compile to WebAssembly, so core operations run locally by default without any installation or data upload. The interface reports scores with their "evidence" (alignments, edit paths, metric matches, search hits, and homology traces), making methods inspectable, debuggable, and comparable on shared inputs. Internal benchmarks show speedups of up to 2,500x over the Python predecessor, faster global/local alignment than a general-purpose native C aligner, and exact agreement with independent references under declared settings. For homology search, the scoped client-side blastn path closely matches NCBI BLAST+ rankings and statistics under matched parameters. A curated showcase and Learn mode present canonical algorithms and metrics as reusable demonstrations. string2string Studio is open-source and freely available at string2string.org.
articles.titleCn: string2string Studio：一个用于字符串到字符串算法的交互式浏览器平台
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了string2string Studio，一个用于自然语言处理、计算生物学和数字人文领域的交互式浏览器平台，用于字符串到字符串的分析。该系统集成了六个主要模块（对齐、距离、相似度、搜索、生成指标和BLAST同源性搜索），可在字符、单词、标记、行和残基级别上运行。其基于C++的算法编译为WebAssembly，因此核心操作默认在本地运行，无需安装或上传数据。界面报告分数及其"证据"（对齐、编辑路径、指标匹配、搜索命中和同源性轨迹），使方法可在共享输入上进行检查、调试和比较。内部基准测试显示，与Python前身相比，速度提升高达2,500倍，比通用原生C对齐器更快地进行全局/局部对齐，并在声明设置下与独立参考完全一致。对于同源性搜索，作用域客户端端的blastn路径在匹配参数下与NCBI BLAST+排名和统计数据紧密匹配。一个经过策划的展示和Learn模式展示了可重用的典型算法和指标。string2string Studio是开源的，并且可以在string2string.org免费获取。

articles.title: HalluTruthQA-4K: A Fine-Grained Corpus and Annotation Process for Arabic Hallucination Detection and Truth Verification
articles.abstract: Large language models can generate fluent Arabic answers while introducing factual errors that are difficult to identify and verify. Existing Arabic hallucination resources often assign a binary label to an entire response, indicating whether it is hallucinated or non-hallucinated, but provide limited information about the exact erroneous content, the reason for the error, or the correct factual answer. We present HalluTruthQA-4K, an expanded version of the HalluTruthQA resource containing 4,000 expert-curated Arabic question-answering instances across four knowledge-intensive domains: Islamic knowledge, history, science, and geography. Serving as the official dataset for Track 2 of the HalluScoring 2026 shared task, HalluTruthQA-4K extends our original corpus to 4,000 instances. Each instance pairs an Arabic question with a model-generated response, a verified reference answer, and five plausible distractors. Hallucinated responses are additionally annotated with character-level erroneous spans, human-written explanations, and hierarchical hallucination types. The corpus contains 1,643 hallucinated and 2,357 non-hallucinated responses, with 1,843 annotated erroneous spans. We describe the resource construction and annotation methodology, including question selection, controlled answer generation, candidate construction, expert annotation, independent verification, adjudication, and quality control. We also document the annotation guidelines, taxonomy, data format, inter-annotator agreement, and corpus statistics. HalluTruthQA-4K provides a reusable resource for hallucination detection, span-level error localization, explanation generation, factual verification, and the broader evaluation of factual reliability in Arabic language models.
articles.titleCn: HalluTruthQA-4K：阿拉伯语幻觉检测与事实核查的细粒度语料库和标注流程
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型能够生成流畅的阿拉伯语回答，但其中常会引入难以识别和核实的事实性错误。现有的阿拉伯语幻觉资源通常对整个回答进行二元标签分类，标示其是否为幻觉回答，但缺乏对具体错误内容、错误原因或正确事实答案的详细信息。我们提出了HalluTruthQA-4K，它是HalluTruthQA资源的一个扩展版本，包含4000个由专家筛选的阿拉伯语问答实例，涵盖四个知识密集型领域：伊斯兰知识、历史、科学和地理。作为HalluScoring 2026共享任务第二赛道的官方数据集，HalluTruthQA-4K将我们的原始语料库扩展至4000个实例。每个实例包含一个阿拉伯语问题、模型生成的回答、经过核实的参考答案以及五个可能的干扰项。幻觉回答额外标注了字符级错误片段、人工编写的解释和层级幻觉类型。语料库包含1643个幻觉回答和2357个非幻觉回答，其中1843个标注了错误片段。我们描述了资源构建和标注方法，包括问题选择、受控回答生成、候选构建、专家标注、独立核实、裁决和质量控制。我们还记录了标注指南、分类体系、数据格式、标注者间一致性以及语料库统计数据。HalluTruthQA-4K为幻觉检测、片段级错误定位、解释生成、事实核实以及阿拉伯语模型事实可靠性更广泛的评估提供了可复用的资源。

articles.title: Logic Before Language: Pre-pretraining on Formal Derivations Fosters Skill Acquisition and Compressibility
articles.abstract: Pre-pretraining language models (LMs) on symbolic data can accelerate and improve natural language acquisition. However, existing pre-pretraining tasks, such as Dyck and procedural algorithms, rely on narrow primitives that fail to capture the expressive capacity of natural language. Moreover, prior studies remain restricted to relatively small token budgets, offering limited insight into skill emergence and representational dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose logic pre-pretraining (Logic-PPT) as a principled initialization strategy, leveraging formal derivations to impart richer structural and linguistic biases. Formal derivations require abstract mechanisms that are central to natural language, simultaneously binding variables, connecting quantifiers and relational dependencies, and composing predicate-argument structures over long contexts. Scaling our evaluation to a 100B-token regime, logic pre-pretraining substantially accelerates skill acquisition in LMs, achieving 80\% accuracy on linguistic tasks with 36B fewer tokens than standard initialization, and outperforming alternative pre-pretraining baselines. Mechanistically, formal derivations induce persistent structural reorganization, distinctively characterized by a lower-rank, spectrally concentrated representation space. Crucially, we show that this internal geometry enables improved model compressibility via pruning, matching the dense baseline performance even at $\approx$33\% sparsity.
articles.titleCn: 逻辑先于语言：在形式演绎上的预预训练促进技能习得和可压缩性
articles.abstractCn: 在符号数据上进行预预训练的语言模型（LMs）可以加速并提升自然语言习得能力。然而，现有的预预训练任务，如Dyck和过程算法，依赖于狭隘的基础操作，无法捕捉自然语言的表达能力。此外，先前研究仍局限于相对较小的token预算，对技能涌现和表征动态的理解有限。为解决这些限制，我们提出逻辑预预训练（Logic-PPT）作为一种原则性初始化策略，利用形式推导来赋予更丰富的结构和语言偏差。形式推导需要自然语言的核心抽象机制，同时绑定变量、连接量词和关系依赖，并在长上下文中组合谓词-论元结构。将我们的评估扩展到100B-token规模，逻辑预预训练显著加速了语言模型的技能习得，在语言任务上达到80%的准确率，比标准初始化少用36B tokens，并优于其他预预训练基线。从机制上看，形式推导诱发了持续的结构重组，其特征是低秩、频谱集中的表征空间。关键的是，我们证明了这种内部几何结构能够通过剪枝提升模型的可压缩性，即使在大约33%的稀疏度下，也能达到密集基线的性能。

articles.title: Sparse Weight Decomposition for Efficient Circuit Extraction
articles.abstract: Dense pretrained transformers do not naturally expose interpretable units for circuit extraction. Existing approaches obtain such units by learning auxiliary sparse representations or training sparse models, incurring substantial additional computation while potentially introducing a fidelity gap between the representation being analyzed and the original pretrained model. We propose Sparse Weight Decomposition (SWD), which reparameterizes pretrained linear projections by factorizing each weight matrix into two sparse factors whose shared intermediate coordinates serve as individually addressable circuit units. Without training a separate replacement network, this parametric representation supports the same scoring, selection, and ablation circuit extraction workflow used for methods that learn sparse features. Across single-matrix replacements, SWD matches the held-out fidelity achieved by Transcoder and other strong baselines while using less than 1% of the data that those baselines use to train their replacements. For matched replacement fidelity, SWD reaches the same circuit sufficiency and necessity targets with fewer active read/write edges and selected units across tasks on GPT-2, Qwen2.5, and Qwen3.5-27B. We further show that SWD remains effective for full-model replacement of all attention and MLP weight matrices after fine-tuning the nonzero factor values. Finally, SWD also features a zero-data variant, allowing broader use of mechanistic interpretability analysis (e.g., per-step analysis).
articles.titleCn: 稀疏权重分解用于高效电路提取
articles.abstractCn: 密集预训练的Transformer模型并不自然地暴露出可解释的单元，用于电路提取。现有方法通过学习辅助稀疏表示或训练稀疏模型来获取此类单元，这会带来巨大的额外计算开销，同时可能引入分析表示与原始预训练模型之间的保真度差距。我们提出了稀疏权重分解（SWD），通过将每个权重矩阵分解为两个稀疏因子，并利用这些因子的共享中间坐标作为可独立寻址的电路单元来重新参数化预训练的线性投影。无需训练单独的替代网络，这种参数化表示支持与学习稀疏特征的方法相同的评分、选择和消融电路提取工作流程。在单矩阵替代方面，SWD达到了Transcoder和其他强基线的保留保真度水平，同时使用的训练数据量不到这些基线所用数据量的1%。对于匹配的替代保真度，SWD在GPT-2、Qwen2.5和Qwen3.5-27B任务上，通过更少的活跃读写边和选定的单元达到了相同的电路充分性和必要性目标。我们进一步证明，在微调非零因子值后，SWD对全部注意力机制和MLP权重矩阵的全模型替代仍然有效。最后，SWD还具备零数据变体，允许更广泛地使用机制可解释性分析（例如，每步分析）。

articles.title: ANNOTARES: A Dataset for Extracting Logical Structures from German Statutory Texts
articles.abstract: The automatic structural analysis of legal texts is a cornerstone of legal technology, yet the extraction of their logical components remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we introduce the task of identifying and segmenting legal conditions (Tatbestand) and legal consequences (Rechtsfolge) within German statutory texts. To support this task, we present ANNOTARES (Annotations of Tatbestand-Rechtsfolge Sequences), a novel dataset comprising German law texts with span-level annotations. Spanning three distinct legal codes, the dataset is designed to evaluate both domain-specific performance and cross-statute generalizability. We benchmark diverse architectural approaches: a rule-based baseline, CRFs, BiLSTMs, BiLSTM-CRF, and modern Transformer-based models, including BERT variants and LLM-based methods. Our results demonstrate that BERT and LLM-based models achieve superior performance in capturing the complex syntactic structures of legal language. We release our dataset to facilitate further research in automated legal reasoning.
articles.titleCn: ANNOTARES：一个用于从德语法规文本中提取逻辑结构的数据库
articles.abstractCn: 法律文本的自动结构分析是法律科技的核心，但其逻辑成分的提取仍是一项重大挑战。本文介绍了在德国法律文本中识别和分割法律条件（Tatbestand）和法律后果（Rechtsfolge）的任务。为支持该任务，我们提出了ANNOTARES（Tatbestand-Rechtsfolge序列注释），一个包含德国法律文本片段级注释的新型数据集。该数据集涵盖三个不同的法律法典，旨在评估特定领域的性能和跨法典的泛化能力。我们对比了多种架构方法：基于规则的基线模型、CRFs、BiLSTMs、BiLSTM-CRF，以及基于现代Transformer的模型，包括BERT变体和基于LLM的方法。我们的结果表明，BERT和基于LLM的模型在捕捉法律语言的复杂句法结构方面表现更优。我们发布该数据集以促进自动化法律推理的进一步研究。

articles.title: BanglaWild: An In-the-Wild Bengali Scene Text Recognition Benchmark for OCR and Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: In-the-wild Bengali scene text recognition is largely unmeasured: existing resources target handwritten documents or constrained sign-board parsing, report only aggregate edit-distance metrics, and evaluate either conventional OCR or VLMs, never both on the same in-the-wild data. To address this gap, we introduce BANGLAWILD, a benchmark of 2,535 Bengali scene text images, each paired with a verbatim gold transcription, two categorical axes, four diagnostic attributes, and an orthographically standard form where the in-image text deviates from canonical spelling. We evaluate fifteen VLMs and three conventional OCR systems under three prompting strategies, fine-tune 6 open-source models with LoRA, and complement edit-distance metrics with an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation. Our results reveal a persistent gap in which larger models within the same family do not outperform smaller ones. Our fifteen-class error taxonomy shows that visual mis-recognition accounts for ~60% of errors in the strongest systems, while conjunct-related errors contribute under 2%, challenging a long-standing assumption in Bengali OCR research; the same visual dominant profile also holds across architectures, including the one conventional baseline that reads Bengali reliably. Prompt language mainly affects cross-script drift and LoRA reduces catastrophic failures in weak models without lifting the ceiling on already competent ones. Code and data will be publicly released.
articles.titleCn: BanglaWild：一个用于OCR和视觉语言模型的野外孟加拉语场景文本识别基准
articles.abstractCn: 在自然场景中的孟加拉文文本识别在很大程度上未被衡量：现有资源主要针对手写文档或受限的招牌解析，仅报告整体编辑距离指标，并且仅在传统OCR或视觉语言模型（VLMs）中评估，从未在同一自然场景数据上同时评估两者。为填补这一空白，我们引入了BANGLAWILD，这是一个包含2,535张孟加拉文场景文本图像的基准，每张图像都配有一份逐字黄金转录文本、两个分类轴、四个诊断属性，以及一个正字法标准形式，其中图像中的文本与规范拼写存在差异。我们在三种提示策略下评估了十五个VLMs和三种传统OCR系统，使用LoRA微调了六个开源模型，并补充了编辑距离指标，采用将大型语言模型作为裁判的评估方法。我们的结果表明，同一系列中较大的模型并未优于较小的模型，存在持续的差距。我们的十五类错误分类显示，在表现最强的系统中，视觉误识别约占错误总数的60%，而与连接符相关的错误不足2%，挑战了孟加拉文OCR研究中的一个长期假设；相同的视觉主导特征也适用于不同的架构，包括那个能够可靠读取孟加拉文的传统基线模型。提示语言主要影响跨脚本漂移，LoRA减少了弱模型中的灾难性失败，但并未提高已具备能力的模型的极限。代码和数据将公开发布。

articles.title: DS@GT-ARC at eRisk 2026 Task 3: Sparse, Semantic, and LLM Reranking for ADHD Symptom Sentences
articles.abstract: This paper describes our submissions to eRisk 2026 Task 3, ADHD Symptom Sentence Ranking. The task requires systems to rank candidate Reddit sentences according to their relevance to each of the 18 symptoms in the Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale (ASRS-v1.1). Because no annotated training data were released for this first edition of the task, we relied on zero-shot experimentation, manual validation, and unsupervised or weakly guided retrieval pipelines. Our systems combine sparse BM25 retrieval, evidence-aware rescoring for self-referential symptom reports, embedding-based reranking, query-prototype expansion, and LLM-based reranking. All submitted systems follow a staged retrieval design in which BM25 retrieves candidates at scale and semantic or LLM rerankers refine the final rankings. Among our submissions, the LLM reranker achieved the strongest official scores, followed by the prototype query-expansion run. Our manual top-10 analysis aligned with the official expert scoring trend, suggesting that staged reranking is a promising direction for further development.
articles.titleCn: eRisk 2026 任务3：针对ADHD症状句子的稀疏、语义和LLM重排序
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了我们在eRisk 2026任务3，即注意力缺陷多动障碍症状句子排序方面的提交。该任务要求系统根据成人注意力缺陷多动障碍自我报告量表（ASRS-v1.1）中的18个症状，对候选Reddit句子进行排序。由于本次任务的第一版未发布标注训练数据，我们依赖于零样本实验、人工验证以及无监督或弱监督检索流程。我们的系统结合了稀疏BM25检索、针对自我指涉症状报告的证据感知重评分、基于嵌入的重排序、查询原型扩展以及基于大型语言模型的重新排序。所有提交的系统均采用分阶段检索设计，其中BM25大规模检索候选，语义或LLM重排序器对最终排序进行优化。在我们的提交中，LLM重排序器取得了最强的官方分数，其次是原型查询扩展运行。我们的手动前10名分析结果与官方专家评分趋势一致，表明分阶段重排序是未来发展的一个有前景的方向。

articles.title: MultiGlobeQA: A Multilingual and Globally Diverse Benchmark for Geospatial Reasoning
articles.abstract: Geospatial reasoning, i.e., computing distances, containment, and other spatial relations over real-world entities, is central to navigation and logistics, yet large language models (LLMs) struggle with the required geometric and topological computation despite storing considerable geographic knowledge. Existing benchmarks localize these failures only partially: they are synthetic or smallscale, largely monolingual, and offer limited control over geographic coverage. We introduce MultiGlobeQA, a multilingual benchmark of 46,060 question-answer pairs spanning 14 spatial-function families and 15 answer formats, with execution-based ground truth over three knowledge graphs. It covers 201 countries and territories via income- and density-stratified sampling, with parallel questions in English and 16 additional high- and low-resource languages. Across parametric, reasoning, and agentic settings, LLMs collapse on tasks requiring grid indexing and shape computation, while topological relations and directions fare best. Retrieval and tool use yield considerable gains, yet performance plateaus below two thirds even when gold facts are supplied, indicating that computation, not access to knowledge, is the bottleneck. Models also underperform on low-income regions, a gap that gold facts widen rather than close.
articles.titleCn: MultiGlobeQA：一个多语言和全球多元化的地理空间推理基准
articles.abstractCn: 地理空间推理，即计算现实世界实体之间的距离、包含关系以及其他空间关系，是导航和物流的核心，然而大型语言模型（LLM）在所需的几何和拓扑计算方面存在困难，尽管它们存储了相当多的地理知识。现有的基准测试只能部分地定位这些缺陷：它们是合成的或小规模的，很大程度上是单语的，并且对地理覆盖范围的控制有限。我们介绍了MultiGlobeQA，这是一个包含46060个问答对的多语言基准测试，涵盖了14个空间功能家族和15种答案格式，具有基于执行的三个知识图谱的真实标签。通过收入和密度分层抽样，它涵盖了201个国家和地区，并提供英语和16种其他高资源量和低资源量的并行问题。在参数化、推理和代理设置中，LLM在需要网格索引和形状计算的任务上表现崩溃，而拓扑关系和方向表现最佳。检索和工具使用带来了相当大的收益，但当提供黄金事实时，性能仍然停滞在三分之二以下，表明瓶颈在于计算而非知识获取。模型在低收入地区也表现不佳，黄金事实非但没有缩小差距，反而扩大了差距。

articles.title: ContinualSkillBench: Can LLM Agents Truly Evolve Their Capabilities?
articles.abstract: Modern agent frameworks equip large language models with external skill libraries to solve complex tasks. However, it remains unclear whether these systems can effectively evolve their skills and whether the resulting skills improve task-solving capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce ContinualSkillBench, a dynamic evaluation framework for in-context continual skill learning. It covers five representative domains, each containing 100 interconnected subtasks ordered by increasing difficulty and opportunities for cross-task skill reuse. Our experiments show that sequential execution generally improves performance, but the gains vary substantially across models and domains. Moreover, in-context learning performs comparably to explicit skill maintenance on average, suggesting that much of the improvement arises from adaptation to prior context and feedback rather than reusable skill abstraction alone. Explicit skills nevertheless provide selective benefits for tasks requiring reusable procedures or precise outputs. We further find that less capable models tend to accumulate larger, more fragmented collections of task-specific skills. These findings show that current in-context skill evolution mechanisms can support continual adaptation, but still struggle to consistently consolidate experience into robust and transferable skills.
articles.titleCn: 持续技能基准：LLM智能体能否真正进化其能力？
articles.abstractCn: 现代智能体框架通过外部技能库使大型语言模型能够解决复杂任务。然而，这些系统是否能够有效进化其技能，以及由此产生的技能是否提升了任务解决能力，目前尚不明确。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了ContinualSkillBench，这是一个用于情境持续技能学习的动态评估框架。该框架涵盖了五个代表性领域，每个领域包含100个按难度递增和跨任务技能复用机会相连的子任务。我们的实验表明，顺序执行通常能提升性能，但模型和领域的增益差异很大。此外，情境学习在平均表现上与显式技能维护相当，表明大部分改进源于对先前上下文和反馈的适应，而不仅仅是可重用技能的抽象。尽管如此，显式技能为需要可重用流程或精确输出的任务提供了选择性优势。我们进一步发现，能力较弱的模型倾向于积累更大、更零散的任务特定技能集合。这些发现表明，当前的情境技能进化机制能够支持持续适应，但仍然难以将经验有效整合为稳健和可迁移的技能。

articles.title: SciRet: A Compute-Aware Empirical Study of Retrieval and Reranking for Scientific RAG
articles.abstract: We introduce SciRet, a compute-aware empirical study of retrieval-augmented generation for scientific question answering over CORD-19. Rather than proposing a new model, we evaluate a fixed scientific RAG pipeline across three corpus scales: 1,034 chunks (1K papers), 5,160 chunks (5K papers), and 15,480 chunks (15K papers). The pipeline combines sentence-window chunking, BM25, BGE-M3 dense retrieval, reciprocal rank fusion, optional cross-encoder reranking, and grounded answer generation. Across these settings, hybrid retrieval is more robust than either sparse-only or dense-only retrieval in our setting, reaching Recall@10 of 1.000 at 1K and 15K. In contrast, an MS MARCO-trained cross-encoder reranker reduces precision on the scientific corpus, suggesting that domain mismatch can outweigh the benefits of stronger query-passage interaction. Generation faithfulness measured with RAGAS increases with corpus scale in our setup. Retrieval evaluation uses pseudo-relevance labels derived from the hybrid system, so we treat the results as controlled comparative evidence rather than a benchmark claim. We release code, indexes, and evaluation outputs to support replication and follow-up studies.
articles.titleCn: SciRet：一项针对科学RAG中检索和重排序的计算感知实证研究
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了SciRet，一项针对CORD-19科学问答检索增强生成的计算感知实证研究。我们没有提出新模型，而是在三种语料库规模下评估了一个固定的科学RAG流程：1,034个片段（1K篇论文）、5,160个片段（5K篇论文）和15,480个片段（15K篇论文）。该流程结合了句子窗口片段化、BM25、BGE-M3密集检索、互惠排名融合、可选的跨编码器重新排序和基于证据的答案生成。在这些设置中，混合检索比仅使用稀疏检索或仅使用密集检索更稳健，在1K和15K时达到了Recall@10的1.000。相比之下，一个基于MS MARCO训练的跨编码器重新排序器降低了科学语料库的精确度，表明领域不匹配可以抵消更强的查询-段落交互带来的好处。在我们的设置中，使用RAGAS测量的生成忠实度随着语料库规模的增加而提高。检索评估使用混合系统派生的伪相关性标签，因此我们将结果视为受控的对比证据，而非基准声明。我们发布了代码、索引和评估输出，以支持可重复研究和后续研究。

articles.title: Beyond Representational Similarity: Source-Conditioned Description-Length Gain for Generative Plagiarism Detection and Candidate Source Reranking
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) pose challenges to academic integrity and peer review. Yet generative plagiarism detection remains an underexplored and largely unresolved challenge. Prior work on LLM-generated-text detection targets AI involvement, which may be permissible, rather than source reuse, while similarity-based methods struggle after extensive rewriting and multi-source synthesis. Motivated by the description-length view of probabilistic prediction, in which relevant side information can reduce a target sequence's code length, we introduce Source-Conditioned Description-Length Gain (SCDG), a directional, training-free framework that contrasts a frozen language model's description length of a suspicious document $P$ with and without a candidate source $S$. This contrast yields token-level log-likelihood gains that measure the incremental predictive evidence supplied by $S$. We evaluate SCDG on the PAN at CLEF benchmarks for generative plagiarism. On a PAN 2025-derived pairwise benchmark, SCDG achieves 0.92 Precision, 0.97 Recall, and 0.94 F1, outperforming all baselines; on PAN 2026's multi-source retrieval task, it reaches 0.83 nDCG@10 and 0.96 Recall@100, surpassing all baselines. On a same-topic, same-event Multi-News test, the calibrated gain-distribution SCDG classifier predicts source reuse for only $0.125\%$ of pairs, supporting robustness to topical overlap under this evaluation protocol. These results establish SCDG as a unified and token-decomposable signal for source-specific content reuse under extensive transformation.
articles.titleCn: 超越表征相似性：生成性剽窃检测和候选源重新排序的源条件描述长度增益
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）对学术诚信和同行评审构成挑战。然而，生成式剽窃检测仍然是一个尚未充分探索且尚未完全解决的难题。以往针对LLM生成文本检测的研究主要关注AI的参与，这或许是可以接受的，而非来源重用，而基于相似度的方法在经过大量改写和多源合成后难以有效工作。受概率预测描述长度观点的启发——其中相关辅助信息可以减少目标序列的编码长度——我们引入了条件描述长度增益（SCDG），这是一个无需训练的方向性框架，通过对比冻结的语言模型在包含候选来源S和不包含S的情况下对可疑文档P的描述长度，产生token级别的对数似然增益，以此衡量S提供的增量预测证据。我们在CLEF的PAN基准测试上评估了SCDG在生成式剽窃检测方面的性能。在一个基于PAN 2025的成对基准测试中，SCDG达到了0.92的精确率、0.97的召回率和0.94的F1值，超越了所有基线模型；在PAN 2026的多源检索任务中，它达到了0.83的nDCG@10和0.96的Recall@100，同样超越了所有基线。在一个同主题、同事件的Multi-News测试中，校准增益分布的SCDG分类器仅对0.125%的成对文本预测为来源重用，表明在该评估协议下对主题重叠的鲁棒性。这些结果确立了SCDG作为一种统一且可token分解的信号，用于在大量转换下检测特定来源的内容重用。

articles.title: Sensitivity, Causality, and Repair Dissociate: A Layer-Wise Analysis of Perturbation Robustness and Its Scaling
articles.abstract: When a language model fails on surface-perturbed input (typos, OCR noise, homophones), "which layer is responsible" has three natural operationalizations: where representations diverge most (sensitivity), where restoring clean activations recovers the prediction (causality), and where a small adapter can repair the damage (compensatory capacity) - and we show these three layer maps dissociate. Across a five-model panel we identify two propagation regimes - spike-and-suppress (Phi-3.5, Gemma-2-9B) and late-accumulation (Llama-3, Mistral, Qwen2.5-7B) - and on the two models meeting an 80% identity-patch gate, sensitivity and causality are anti-correlated (rho = -0.72 to -0.88). Within-family scaling on Qwen2.5 (1.5B to 14B) shows the late-accumulation signature strengthening monotonically with scale, corroborated on a second family. We propose cascade disruption as the mechanism behind the dissociation: adapters placed at causally implicated early layers break intact downstream computation, making diagnostic-flagged sites the worst adapter placements. A fixed-harness layer sweep across four models (3.8-8B) confirms the core prediction on chain-of-thought GSM8K - the flagged sites are the most damaging adapter windows on every adjudicable model - and is sign-consistent but strongly attenuated on a multiple-choice control, consistent with damage that compounds with generation length. The sweep yields practical guidance: a training-free LRD pre-screen and a default-deepest placement rule, though absolute gains over no-adapter baselines remain small. Finally, apparent gains from a representation-stability loss reverse under an adequate generation budget - truncated chain-of-thought had been scored as empty - a methodological warning for any intervention evaluated on chain-of-thought tasks.
articles.titleCn: 敏感性、因果关系与修复分离：扰动鲁棒性及其规模的多层分析
articles.abstractCn: 当语言模型在表面扰动输入（拼写错误、OCR噪声、同音异义词）上失效时，“哪个层负责”有三个自然的操作化方式：表征差异最大的地方（敏感性）、恢复干净激活后能够恢复预测的地方（因果性）以及一个小适配器可以修复损伤的地方（补偿能力）——我们展示了这三个层映射是分离的。在五个模型面板中，我们识别出两种传播机制——脉冲抑制（Phi-3.5、Gemma-2-9B）和后期累积（Llama-3、Mistral、Qwen2.5-7B）——在两个满足80%身份补丁门的模型上，敏感性和因果性呈负相关（rho = -0.72至-0.88）。在Qwen2.5（1.5B至14B）的家族内部缩放显示后期累积特征随着规模单调增强，并在第二个家族上得到证实。我们提出级联中断是分离背后的机制：放置在因果关联早期层的适配器会破坏下游完整计算，使得诊断标记的位点成为适配器放置最差的地方。在四个模型（3.8-8B）上的固定框架层扫描确认了对思维链GSM8K的核心预测——标记的位点在每个可裁决模型上都是最具破坏性的适配器窗口——结果符号一致但在多项选择控制上强烈衰减，这与随着生成长度增加而累积的损伤一致。扫描提供了实用指导：无训练的LRD预筛选和默认最深放置规则，尽管相对于无适配器基线的绝对收益仍然很小。最后，表征稳定性损失带来的明显收益在充足的生成预算下会逆转——被评分空的截断思维链——对任何在思维链任务上评估的干预措施的方法学警告。

articles.title: VIBE: A VAD-Informed Benchmark for Entity-Centered Affective Profiling of Large Language Model Outputs
articles.abstract: Large language models routinely describe socially salient targets, including political figures, countries, religions, organizations, historical events, and social groups, encoding affective framing alongside factual content: a target may appear favorable or threatening, calm or conflictual, powerful or vulnerable. Existing work captures parts of this space through sentiment, favorability, and emotion benchmarks, but none combines target-directed VAD attribution, an explicit scorer contract, and a passport reporting format. We introduce VIBE, a benchmark for entity-centered affective profiling of LLM outputs in Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) space. Its core contribution is a measurement contract: VIBE separates generation from external scoring, distinguishes scalar favorability, response-level VAD, and target-directed VAD, and reports profiles through an Affective Passport. Three empirical layers support the contract. H1 shows scalar favorability does not subsume arousal and dominance: valence findings are cross-validated (rV = 0.944 judge-human, rV = 0.954 inter-scorer); arousal and dominance are single-scorer directional estimates, not point-precise, consistent with known inter-annotator difficulty on these axes (rA = 0.495, rD = 0.702 among human annotators). H2 shows whole-response and target-directed VAD are different contracts: the same text can carry one affective tone overall while representing the named target differently. H3 is a protocol-drift diagnostic: elicitation conditions shift profiles, motivating context metadata in every affective report. These results motivate entity-centered affective profiling as a documented practice: profiles should be released with scorer identity, coverage, protocol, and interpretation limits.
