articles.titleCn: VIBE：一个基于VAD信息的实体中心情感分析基准，用于大型语言模型输出
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型通常描述具有社会显著性的目标，包括政治人物、国家、宗教、组织、历史事件和社会群体，同时编码情感框架和事实内容：目标可能显得有利或威胁，平静或冲突，强大或脆弱。现有工作通过情感、倾向性和情绪基准捕捉了部分这一领域，但没有任何工作结合了目标导向的效价-唤醒度-支配度（VAD）归因、明确的评分契约以及护照式报告格式。我们引入了VIBE，一个用于在效价-唤醒度-支配度（VAD）空间中对大型语言模型输出进行实体中心情感分析的基准。其核心贡献是一个测量契约：VIBE将生成与外部评分分离，区分标量倾向性、响应级VAD和目标导向VAD，并通过情感护照报告特征。三个实证层次支持这一契约。H1表明标量倾向性并不涵盖唤醒度和支配度：效价发现得到交叉验证（rV = 0.944人机，rV = 0.954评分者间）；唤醒度和支配度是单评分者的方向性估计而非精确点估计，这与已知在这些轴上标注者间难度相符（rA = 0.495，rD = 0.702在人类标注者间）。H2表明整体响应和目标导向VAD是不同的契约：同一文本可以整体上带有一种情感基调，同时却以不同的方式代表命名目标。H3是一个协议漂移诊断：激发条件会改变特征，这促使在每次情感报告中加入上下文元数据。这些结果推动了实体中心情感分析作为一种记录在案的实践：特征应随评分者身份、覆盖范围、协议和解释限制一起发布。

articles.title: M-GATE: Multilingual Grammar, Accuracy in Translation, and Efficiency Benchmark for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Multilingual language models are deployed across a hundred or more languages, yet most benchmarks test whether a model can perform a task _in_ a language rather than whether it commands the language itself, conflating fluency with proficiency. We introduce M-GATE (Multilingual Grammar, Accuracy in Translation, and Efficiency), a benchmark of linguistic proficiency spanning 30 typologically diverse languages from high- to low-resource. M-GATE comprises three tasks: grammatical error detection on linguist-crafted, adversarially selected sentences that turn on hard, language-specific phenomena; round-trip translation of shared English sources across 29 target languages, scored by a three-provider LLM judge panel validated against professional annotators; and a supplementary tokenizer-efficiency measure. We evaluate over 50 models in more than 80 configurations. Fluency and proficiency come apart sharply: models that translate competently sit near chance on the adversarial grammar items, the best reaching a Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) of only 0.36, and their errors lean systematically toward under-flagging, accepting ungrammatical text rather than raising false alarms. Translation quality closely tracks a language's share of pretraining data (r = 0.86 against log Common Crawl share), producing a steep low-resource penalty that is nonetheless narrowing with successive model releases. Enabling reasoning reliably improves translation, while its effect on error detection is smaller and for some models negative, so the best configuration is task-dependent. To resist contamination, test items are kept private behind a continuously updated public leaderboard, with illustrative examples released (https://m-gate.ai).
articles.titleCn: M-GATE：多语言语法、翻译准确性和效率基准测试，用于大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 多语言语言模型已部署于百种以上语言，但大多数基准测试仅评估模型能否在特定语言中执行任务，而非评估其语言掌握程度，从而混淆了流利度与熟练度。我们引入M-GATE（多语言语法、翻译准确性与效率）基准，涵盖30种类型学多样性语言（从高资源到低资源），评估语言熟练度。M-GATE包含三项任务：针对语言学家设计、对抗性筛选的句子进行语法错误检测，揭示语言特有的难点现象；29种目标语言共享英语源文本的往返翻译，由三位提供者的大型语言模型评委小组评分，并与专业标注者验证；以及补充的标记器效率指标。我们评估了50余种模型，超过80种配置。流利度与熟练度显著分离：能胜任翻译的模型在对抗性语法项目中表现接近随机水平，最佳模型的马修斯相关系数（MCC）仅为0.36，其错误系统性地倾向于低估，接受非语法文本而非产生误报。翻译质量与语言在预训练数据中的占比密切相关（对数Common Crawl占比相关系数r=0.86），导致低资源语言面临巨大惩罚，但随模型迭代差距正在缩小。推理能力可靠提升翻译质量，对错误检测的影响较小且对部分模型为负，最佳配置因任务而异。为防止污染，测试项目保持私密，通过持续更新的公开排行榜发布，并公开示例（https://m-gate.ai）。

articles.title: Efficient Knowledge Distillation for LLMs: Offline Top-K Logits and a Fused Chunked KL Loss
articles.abstract: Small language models are often the only option for deployment under tight latency, cost, and on-premises constraints, but they are rarely trained from scratch: a compressed model is usually recovered through knowledge distillation (KD). This recovery step largely decides the final quality, yet it is expensive. We present a practitioner's study of how to make distillation training efficient, organised around two systems contributions. First, we show that offline KD (caching the teacher's top-$K$ logits once and training the student against the cache) matches online distillation at near-identical training loss while removing the teacher from memory, running about 29\% faster per iteration, and reaching up to 41\% higher throughput on a single H200 GPU. Second, we introduce a \emph{fused, chunked KL loss} that never materialises the full vocabulary-sized logit tensor, making peak memory linear in the sequence length. This removes the memory spike that otherwise caps context length and lets us train at four times the context (32{,}768 tokens) on a single GPU. A separate output-head-only toy benchmark isolates the loss kernel and confirms its memory and iteration-rate scaling from 4K to 256K tokens. Together these make large-scale healing and hundreds of ablations affordable. We also report supporting ablations on loss design and sequence packing. We release our chunked-loss implementation: https://github.com/CompactifAI/Full-Chunked-KL-Loss.
articles.titleCn: 面向大型语言模型的效率知识蒸馏：离线Top-K logits与融合分块KL损失
articles.abstractCn: 在严格的延迟、成本和本地部署限制下，小型语言模型通常是唯一的选择，但它们很少从头开始训练：通常通过知识蒸馏（KD）来恢复压缩模型。这一恢复步骤很大程度上决定了最终质量，但成本高昂。我们通过两个系统贡献，对如何使蒸馏训练高效进行了实践者研究。首先，我们证明离线KD（缓存教师模型的top-K logits一次，并让学生模型针对缓存进行训练）在几乎相同的训练损失下匹配在线蒸馏，同时从内存中移除教师模型，每次迭代运行速度提高约29%，在单个H200 GPU上吞吐量提升高达41%。其次，我们引入了一种\emph{融合、分块KL损失}，它永远不会生成完整词汇大小的logit张量，使得峰值内存与序列长度呈线性关系。这消除了原本限制上下文长度的内存峰值，使我们能够在单个GPU上以四倍的上下文（32{,}768个token）进行训练。一个独立的仅输出头部的玩具基准将损失内核隔离出来，并证实了其在4K到256K token范围内的内存和迭代速率扩展性。这些共同使得大规模修复和数百次消融实验变得可行。我们还报告了关于损失设计和序列打包的辅助消融实验。我们发布了我们的分块损失实现：https://github.com/CompactifAI/Full-Chunked-KL-Loss。

articles.title: Evaluating LLMs in Database Scenarios: A Lifecycle Benchmark for Assessing Their Potential in Core Database Tasks
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming database interaction paradigms, evolving from simple query translators to autonomous database administrators (DBAs). However, current evaluation benchmarks remain disproportionately fixated on Text-to-SQL tasks, neglecting the holistic Database Lifecycle-from initial schema design to post-deployment maintenance. This narrow focus fails to capture the diverse capabilities required for real-world database management. To bridge this gap, we introduce DBLifeBench, the first benchmark to evaluate LLMs across five critical lifecycle phases: Design, Implementation, Operation, Debugging, and Maintenance. Furthermore, addressing the cognitive mismatch between ambiguous natural language and complex SQL logic, we propose Progressive-Text2SQL, a novel task utilizing structured reasoning graphs to mimic human iterative problem-solving. Our extensive evaluation reveals a critical insight: while general-purpose models demonstrate balanced performance, specialized Text-to-SQL models suffer from ``catastrophic forgetting'' in non-coding phases like design and maintenance. DBLifeBench serves as a foundational step toward evaluating and building true full-stack database intelligence.
articles.titleCn: 在数据库场景中评估大型语言模型：一个用于评估其在核心数据库任务中潜力的生命周期基准
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正在改变数据库交互范式，从简单的查询翻译器演变为自主的数据库管理员（DBAs）。然而，当前的评估基准仍然不成比例地集中于Text-to-SQL任务，忽视了从初始模式设计到部署后维护的数据库生命周期整体。这种狭隘的焦点未能捕捉现实世界数据库管理所需的多样化能力。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了DBLifeBench，这是首个评估LLMs在五个关键生命周期阶段（设计、实施、运营、调试和维护）的基准。此外，为了解决模糊的自然语言与复杂SQL逻辑之间的认知不匹配问题，我们提出了Progressive-Text2SQL这一新任务，该任务利用结构化推理图来模拟人类的迭代问题解决过程。我们的广泛评估揭示了一个关键洞察：通用模型表现出均衡的性能，而专门的Text-to-SQL模型在非编码阶段（如设计和维护）存在“灾难性遗忘”问题。DBLifeBench为评估和构建真正的全栈数据库智能奠定了基础。

articles.title: MDLMPE: Distribution Aware Positional Encoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) enable parallel generation and bidirectional context modeling, but their positional context differs fundamentally from that of autoregressive (AR) models. Whereas AR decoding exposes a contiguous prefix, MDLM denoising produces dynamic, non-contiguous configurations of revealed and masked tokens. Conventional positional encodings such as RoPE capture sequence order and pairwise displacement but remain insensitive to this evolving token-availability structure. To address this limitation, we propose MDLMPE, a positional encoding designed specifically for masked diffusion. To the best of our knowledge, MDLMPE is the first method to make positional representations explicitly aware of the changing revealed/masked configuration. It represents token availability as a binary sequence, applies distance-aware Gaussian weighting, and projects the resulting pattern through a cosine basis to obtain distribution-aware positional features. These features are added to token embeddings and mapped by a lightweight MLP to angular offsets that modulate the standard RoPE phases. Extensive experiments on LLaDA and DREAM demonstrate that MDLMPE generally outperforms conventional positional encoding methods across supervised fine-tuning, pretraining, zero-shot evaluation, and block-diffusion settings. Further ablations show that the complete combination of availability state, Gaussian locality, spectral basis, and embedding injection yields the strongest result. These results establish the evolving token-availability distribution as a useful positional signal for masked diffusion language models.
articles.titleCn: MDLMPE：针对掩码扩散语言模型的分布感知位置编码
articles.abstractCn: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs）能够并行生成和双向上下文建模，但其位置上下文与自回归（AR）模型存在根本差异。AR解码会暴露连续的前缀，而MDLM去噪则产生动态、非连续的已揭示和掩码标记配置。传统的位置编码如RoPE能够捕捉序列顺序和成对位移，但对这种不断变化的标记可用性结构不敏感。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了MDLMPE，一种专为掩码扩散设计的位置编码。据我们所知，MDLMPE是首个使位置表示明确感知已揭示/掩码配置变化的方法。它将标记可用性表示为二进制序列，应用距离感知的高斯加权，并通过余弦基将所得模式投影以获得分布感知的位置特征。这些特征被添加到标记嵌入中，并由轻量级MLP映射为角度偏移，以调制标准RoPE相位。在LLaDA和DREAM上的大量实验表明，MDLMPE在监督微调、预训练、零样本评估和块扩散设置中普遍优于传统位置编码方法。进一步的消融实验显示，可用性状态、高斯局部性、频谱基和嵌入注入的完整组合产生了最佳结果。这些结果确立了不断变化的标记可用性分布作为掩码扩散语言模型的有用位置信号。

articles.title: Risky Business: Measuring The Faithfulness-Safety Tension
articles.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning offers a promising window into model monitoring. However, monitoring relies on faithfulness, i.e., the model output strictly derives from its reasoning trace. We identify an alignment tension where a model must be faithful enough to be monitored, yet robust enough to reject unsafe reasoning. We demonstrate that this counterbalance exists in current Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), and show ways in which it can be addressed. We introduce HazMart, a human-written dataset set in an autonomous AI shopkeeper scenario. Unlike prior work that relies on providing hints in prompts to test faithfulness (e.g., "A Stanford professor said it should be Answer A"), we propose a novel replacement-based technique, which we call Targeted Reasoning Replacement (TRR), that directly intervenes in the reasoning chain to substitute in unsafe or illogical thoughts (e.g., "Wait, the answer must be Option B [was Option A] because it is the most fitting"). DeepSeek-R1-Llama-70B exhibits high faithfulness (97.5%) but fails to reject Unsafe Reasoning (12.3%), while QwQ-32B is more robust (73.9% safety) at the cost of lower faithfulness (74.7%). Mechanistic analyses of QwQ-32B reveal that these properties are represented by anti-correlated internal directions peaking at the action-commit token. Finally, we demonstrate that representation steering can independently amplify the safety direction, increasing safe behavior by 9 percentage points while maintaining base capabilities.
articles.titleCn: 风险业务：衡量忠诚度-安全性之间的张力
articles.abstractCn: 思维链（CoT）推理为模型监控提供了一个有前景的窗口。然而，监控依赖于保真度，即模型输出严格源自其推理轨迹。我们识别出一种一致性张力，即模型必须足够保真以供监控，同时又足够鲁棒以拒绝不安全的推理。我们证明这种平衡关系存在于当前的大型推理模型（LRMs）中，并展示了如何解决这一问题。我们引入了HazMart，这是一个设定在自主AI店员场景下的人工编写的数据集。与以往依赖在提示中提供线索来测试保真度的工作（例如，“斯坦福大学教授说应该选择A”）不同，我们提出了一种新颖的替换技术，称为目标推理替换（TRR），该技术直接干预推理链，以替换不安全或逻辑不合理的想法（例如，“等等，答案必须是选项B[原来是A]，因为它最合适”）。DeepSeek-R1-Llama-70B表现出高保真度（97.5%），但未能拒绝不安全推理（12.3%），而QwQ-32B在牺牲保真度（74.7%）的情况下更鲁棒（73.9%的安全性）。对QwQ-32B的机制分析揭示，这些特性由在行动承诺标记处达到峰值的负相关内部方向表示。最后，我们证明表示引导可以独立地增强安全方向，在保持基础能力的同时将安全行为提高了9个百分点。

articles.title: An Actionable Diagnosis of Multilingual, Multi-Agent Planning Failures
articles.abstract: Multilingual multi-agent systems exhibit substantial degradation beyond English, yet prior work rarely identifies how task-critical information is lost when user requests are converted into executable plans. We study the planner in a multi-agent system as the request-to-action interface and derive an actionable taxonomy of planning-grounding failures from failed real-world task executions. LLM-based analysis shows that these failures constitute an increasing share of unsuccessful executions as language-resource availability declines, with the strongest effects in low-resource languages. To test whether the taxonomy supports mitigation, we introduce TART, Taxonomy-Guided Actionable Representation, that makes the taxonomy's key aspects explicit to the planner and downstream sub-agents. Across multiple languages, three LLM backbones, two datasets, and two agentic configurations, TART consistently improves performance. On multilingual GAIA, it raises a state-of-the-art system's accuracy by 5.6 percentage points averaged across eleven languages spanning low- to high-resource settings.
articles.titleCn: 多语言、多智能体规划失败的可操作诊断
articles.abstractCn: 多语言多智能体系统在英语之外表现出显著的性能下降，但以往研究很少识别在用户请求转化为可执行计划时，任务关键信息是如何丢失的。我们研究多智能体系统中的规划器作为请求到行动的接口，并从失败的现实任务执行中推导出一个可操作的规划基础失败分类法。基于大型语言模型的分析表明，随着语言资源可用性的下降，这些失败在未成功执行中占比不断增加，在低资源语言中影响最为显著。为了测试该分类法是否支持缓解措施，我们引入了TART（分类法指导的可操作表示），它将分类法的关键方面显式地呈现给规划器和下游子智能体。在多种语言、三个LLM主干网络、两个数据集和两种智能体配置中，TART始终如一地提升了性能。在多语言GAIA上，它将一个最先进系统的平均准确率在跨越从低资源到高资源设置的11种语言中提高了5.6个百分点。

articles.title: GPTKB 2.0: Direct Construction of Disambiguated Knowledge Bases from Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Automated Knowledge Base Construction (AKBC) is a core NLP task, and recent work proposes generating knowledge bases directly from large language models (LLMs), treating the model itself as the knowledge source. However, LLMs natively possess no representation of entities, leading to duplicate entries as well as conflations. We propose GPTKB 2.0, a methodology for constructing disambiguated KBs directly from LLMs. GPTKB 2.0 incorporates on-the-fly disambiguation of entities, relations and classes, and is meticulously designed to satisfy both scalability and disambiguation accuracy. We analyze the central design decisions and characterize the trade-offs between accuracy, scale, and cost. We execute GPTKB 2.0 at scale, obtaining a materialized KB containing over 1M disambiguated entities and 38.4M triples. This represents the first million-scale LLM-native KB with explicit internal canonicalization of entities, relations, and classes, a significant departure from prior Wikimedia-centric works. GPTKB 2.0 is available at https://gptkb.org/.
articles.titleCn: GPTKB 2.0：从大型语言模型直接构建消歧知识库
articles.abstractCn: 自动化知识库构建（AKBC）是一项核心的自然语言处理任务，近期研究提出直接从大型语言模型（LLMs）生成知识库，将模型本身视为知识来源。然而，LLMs天生不具备实体表示，导致出现重复条目和混淆。我们提出了GPTKB 2.0，一种直接从LLMs构建消歧知识库的方法。GPTKB 2.0结合了实时的实体、关系和类别的消歧，精心设计以满足可扩展性和消歧准确性的要求。我们分析了核心设计决策，并描述了准确率、规模和成本之间的权衡。我们大规模执行GPTKB 2.0，获得了一个包含超过100万个消歧实体和3840万个三元组的实体化知识库。这代表了首个具有明确内部实体、关系和类别规范化的一百万规模LLMs原生知识库，与以往的维基百科中心化工作存在显著差异。GPTKB 2.0可在https://gptkb.org/获取。

articles.title: When Outputs Disperse, Does Epistemic Revision Follow? A Black-Box Diagnostic for Machine Collectives
articles.abstract: Collective intelligence research treats disagreement as evidence of epistemic diversity: if agents express different views, the group should retain capacity to revise. In LLM collectives this proxy can break: agents can produce diverse-looking arguments while preserving the same conclusion. We operationalize dispersion-revision coupling: the degree to which an intervention that verifiably increases the dispersion of a collective's outputs in embedding space is accompanied by genuine revision of its epistemic stance rather than premise-preserving reformulation. The diagnostic is black-box: it operates on generated text alone and makes no claims about the internal representations of the generating models. Two channels are measured independently: an output channel, the Coherence Index (CI), verifies that the intervention changed output dispersion; an epistemic channel, per-turn stance annotation, measures whether the collective revised. We propose CI with the Meta-Predictive Clarity System (MPCS), which inserts a Re-Differentiation Protocol (RDP) when outputs over-converge, as a reusable method for estimating this coupling regime. We evaluate five-agent collectives from two configurations (gpt-4o-mini and gemini-2.5-flash; 310 paired episodes per condition). On gpt-4o-mini, conditional dissent improves false-premise recovery by +17.7 points (p<1e-6) while static persona diversity harms recovery (-8.1, p=.007). On gemini-2.5-flash, the same intervention at a comparable budget yields no gain (26.1% vs 27.1%, p=.84) despite a verified dispersion drop; the two treatment effects differ from each other (z=3.79, p<.001). Mechanism tagging shows Gemini preserves the false premise via intra-framework dissent: 94% of tagged post-RDP responses reformulate rather than concede (vs 24% on GPT). We recommend reporting per-intervention stance shift and premise-preservation rate alongside accuracy.

articles.titleCn: 当输出分散时，认知修正会随之而来吗？一种针对机器群体的黑盒诊断方法
articles.abstractCn: 集体智能研究将分歧视为知识多样性证据：若智能体表达不同观点，群体应保留修正能力。在大型语言模型集体中，这一代理指标可能失效：智能体可生成看似多样但结论相同的论证。我们操作化分散-修正耦合：验证性增加集体输出嵌入空间分散度的干预措施，伴随其知识立场真实修正而非前提保留重述的程度。该诊断方法为黑盒：仅作用于生成文本，不涉及生成模型的内部表征。独立测量两个通道：输出通道（一致性指数CI）验证干预是否改变输出分散度；知识通道（回合立场标注）测量集体是否修正。我们提出CI结合元预测清晰系统（MPCS），当输出过度收敛时插入再分化协议（RDP），作为估计此耦合状态的通用方法。我们评估了两种配置（gpt-4o-mini和gemini-2.5-flash）的五智能体集体（每组310对回合）。在gpt-4o-mini上，条件性异议使错误前提修正提升+17.7分（p<1e-6），而静态角色多样性损害修正能力（-8.1，p=.007）。在gemini-2.5-flash上，相同干预在相似预算下无增益（26.1% vs 27.1%，p=.84），尽管分散度确有下降；两种处理效果存在显著差异（z=3.79，p<.001）。机制标注显示Gemini通过框架内异议保留错误前提：94%的标注后RDP响应重述而非承认（GPT为24%）。我们建议报告每干预立场转变及前提保留率，并附带准确率。

articles.title: Detecting Hallucinations and Recovering Verified Answers in Arabic Islamic Question Answering
articles.abstract: Large language models can generate fluent responses to Islamic questions while introducing factual errors that are difficult to identify. This paper presents our system for \textsc{HalluScoring 2026} Task 2.1, \textit{Islamic Hallucination Detection and Find the Truth}. The task requires a unified two-step prediction: determining whether an Arabic answer generated by an LLM is hallucinated and selecting the verified answer from six closely related candidate options. We use the Islamic knowledge dataset provided by the shared task, which contains 600 question--answer instances, including 341 hallucinated and 259 non-hallucinated answers. Our system is based on the fine-tuned \texttt{google/gemma-4-12B-it} model and uses deterministic decoding during inference. The generated outputs are normalized to extract the hallucination label and the selected option. The system achieves a Macro-F1 score of 0.928 and a label accuracy of 0.935 for hallucination detection, together with an option accuracy of 0.895 for answer selection. These results yield a combined score of 0.912, demonstrating strong performance across both stages of the task. The lower option-selection accuracy indicates that distinguishing the verified answer from plausible alternatives remains more challenging than detecting hallucinated responses.
articles.titleCn: 检测阿拉伯伊斯兰问答中的幻觉并恢复已验证答案
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型能够针对伊斯兰问题生成流畅的回答，但会引入难以识别的事实性错误。本文介绍了我们为HalluScoring 2026任务2.1，即《伊斯兰幻觉检测与查找真相》所设计的系统。该任务要求进行统一的两步预测：判断LLM生成的阿拉伯语回答是否为幻觉，并从六个密切相关的候选选项中选择已验证的答案。我们使用了共享任务提供的伊斯兰知识数据集，其中包含600个问答实例，包括341个幻觉回答和259个非幻觉回答。我们的系统基于微调的google/gemma-4-12B-it模型，并在推理过程中使用确定性解码。生成的输出经过归一化处理，以提取幻觉标签和所选选项。该系统在幻觉检测方面取得了0.928的宏F1分数和0.935的标签准确率，在答案选择方面达到了0.895的选项准确率。这些结果综合得分为0.912，展示了在任务两个阶段均表现出色。选项选择准确率的较低值表明，将已验证的答案与看似合理的替代选项区分开来，比检测幻觉回答更具挑战性。

articles.title: Attention is Case-Sensitive
articles.abstract: In human visual perception, uppercase lettering serves as a natural salience cue that captures attention within lowercase text. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical characterization study revealing that Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit an analogous property: letter casing modulates internal attention allocation. Through analysis across 13 models, nine LLMs and four Vision-Language Models (VLMs), with diverse tokenization schemes, we show that formatting target information in alternating or uppercase against a lowercase context concentrates attention on those textual spans. In text this effect is universal, holding across every evaluated non-reasoning model. We frame it as a previously under-explored latent property of pretrained transformers rather than a prescriptive method. Our investigation reveals a central attention-performance divergence: while this "casing effect" robustly shifts attention, its impact on downstream accuracy is non-trivial, increased concentration does not inherently improve task accuracy and, in high-entropy contexts like alternating case, can degrade it. We further identify a boundary condition: the deliberative "thinking" phase in reasoning models acts as a semantic buffer that mitigates typographic sensitivity in text. Extending the study to VLMs, we find the effect transfers partially: the same prompt-side casing reorganizes cross-modal attention along two coupled axes, predominantly a macroscopic disengagement from the image toward the text prompt, and secondarily a concentration of the residual visual attention on the target region. By isolating casing as a zero-shot mechanism for attention steering that requires no model access or fine-tuning, we provide a new foundational understanding of how pretraining internalizes typographic emphasis.
articles.titleCn: 注意区分大小写
articles.abstractCn: 在人类视觉感知中，大写字母作为自然显著性线索，能在小写文本中吸引注意力。本文系统性地实证研究了揭示大型语言模型（LLMs）具有类似特性：字母大小写调节内部注意力分配。通过对13个模型的分析，包括9个LLMs和4个视觉语言模型（VLMs），这些模型具有不同的分词方案，我们表明，在大小写文本背景下，以交替或大写格式呈现目标信息会集中注意力在这些文本片段上。这种效应在文本中具有普适性，适用于所有评估的非推理模型。我们将此视为预训练Transformer先前未充分探索的潜在特性，而非规范性方法。我们的研究揭示了一个核心的注意力-性能差异：虽然这种“大小写效应”能稳健地转移注意力，但其对下游准确性的影响并非微不足道，增加集中度并不必然提高任务准确性，在高熵环境（如交替大小写）中甚至可能降低准确性。我们进一步识别了一个边界条件：推理模型中的审慎“思考”阶段充当语义缓冲器，减轻文本中的排版敏感性。将研究扩展到VLMs，我们发现该效应部分转移：相同的提示侧大小写重组了跨模态注意力沿两个耦合轴的分配，主要表现为从图像到文本提示的宏观脱离，其次为残余视觉注意力在目标区域的集中。通过将大小写隔离为无需模型访问或微调的零样本注意力引导机制，我们提供了关于预训练如何内化排版强调的新基础理解。

articles.title: Predicting Deep Neural Network Training Outcomes from Early Training Telemetry
articles.abstract: Large hyperparameter sweeps for deep neural networks spend substantial compute on configurations that are effectively doomed from the first few epochs. We study whether a single training run's own early telemetry - per-epoch loss, training accuracy, gradient signal-to-noise ratio, weight-norm growth, and an activation-saturation snapshot - together with its sampled hyperparameters, can predict that run's eventual outcome without reference to other runs. We evaluate three prediction tasks: final test accuracy, relative performance within a domain, and training-dynamics failure, including numerical divergence. Across 23,788 training runs spanning six architecture/dataset combinations, gradient-boosted trees using only the first five epochs of telemetry achieve R^2 = 0.92-0.99 for final-accuracy regression and ROC-AUC = 0.983-0.998 for relative classification on a permanently held-out set of hyperparameter configurations. Useful prediction is already available after a single epoch. A paired ablation shows that gradient- and weight-level telemetry provides a statistically consistent improvement over loss and accuracy curves alone, although the practical gain varies by domain. Transfer is strong between similar architectures, while cross-dataset transfer is limited mainly by differences in accuracy scale rather than loss of the underlying relationship. These results suggest that early-training telemetry can provide a practical decision-support signal for compute allocation while motivating human oversight for any automated intervention.
articles.titleCn: 从早期训练遥测数据预测深度神经网络训练结果
articles.abstractCn: 深度神经网络的大型超参数扫描在许多从一开始就注定失败的训练配置上耗费了大量计算资源。我们研究了单个训练运行的早期遥测数据——每轮的损失、训练准确率、梯度信噪比、权重范数增长以及激活饱和快照——连同其采样的超参数，是否能够在不参考其他运行的情况下预测该运行最终的结果。我们评估了三项预测任务：最终测试准确率、领域内的相对性能以及训练动态失败（包括数值发散）。在涵盖六种架构/数据集组合的23,788次训练运行中，仅使用前五轮遥测数据的梯度提升树在永久保留的超参数配置集上实现了最终准确率回归的R^2 = 0.92-0.99和相对分类的ROC-AUC = 0.983-0.998。有用的预测在单轮后即可获得。配对消融实验表明，梯度级和权重级遥测数据相较于单独的损失和准确率曲线提供了统计上的一致性改进，尽管实际收益因领域而异。相似架构之间的迁移能力强，而跨数据集的迁移主要受准确率尺度差异的限制而非底层关系的丢失。这些结果表明，早期训练遥测数据可以为计算资源分配提供实用的决策支持信号，同时促使对任何自动化干预进行人工监督。

articles.title: When Agents Learn to Be You: Benchmarking Privacy Leakage, Impersonation Risk, and Defenses in Persona Skills
articles.abstract: Persona skills distill personal interaction histories into portable and executable artifacts for downstream agents. While enabling flexible personalization, this process concentrates fragmented personal signals, amplifies their impact through reuse, and challenges defenses designed for individual records or retrieval-based memory. To systematically investigate the safety of the persona-skill pipeline, we introduce AntiSkillBench, an end-to-end benchmark for evaluating risks and defenses across the persona-skill pipeline. It comprises: (i) a dataset of 7,500 persona-grounded dialogue traces, constructed from 50 behaviorally rich profiles spanning diverse task scenarios; (ii) an evaluation suite that measures skill-level privacy leakage and agent-level attribute disclosure and behavioral impersonation across three skill-distillation strategies; and (iii) a defense evaluation covering four configurations across online and post-hoc interventions, including active risk suppression and passive provenance protection. Experiments across three frontier agents show that persona-skill risks persist across agent backbones and distillation protocols, extending from explicit attributes to communication styles and personality traits. Existing defenses exhibit limited and distillation-dependent effectiveness, failing to generalize across risk and distillation strategies. These results highlight AntiSkillBench as a challenging benchmark for developing privacy-preserving and authenticity-aware persona skills.
articles.titleCn: 当代理学习成为你：基准测试角色技能中的隐私泄露、模仿风险和防御
articles.abstractCn: 角色技能将个人交互历史提炼为可携带和可执行的工件，供下游代理使用。虽然这一过程支持灵活的个性化，但它将零散的个人信号集中起来，通过重复使用放大其影响，并挑战针对单个记录或基于检索的记忆设计的防御机制。为了系统地研究角色技能流程的安全性，我们引入了AntiSkillBench，这是一个用于评估角色技能流程中风险和防御的端到端基准。它包含：(i) 一个包含7,500条基于角色的对话轨迹的数据集，这些轨迹由50个行为丰富的个人资料构成，涵盖了多样化的任务场景；(ii) 一个评估套件，用于测量三种技能蒸馏策略下的技能级隐私泄露、代理级属性披露和行为模仿；(iii) 一个防御评估，涵盖在线和事后干预的四种配置，包括主动风险抑制和被动来源保护。在三个前沿代理上的实验表明，角色技能风险贯穿于代理骨干和蒸馏协议，从显式属性扩展到沟通风格和人格特质。现有防御措施表现出有限且依赖蒸馏策略的有效性，无法泛化到不同的风险和蒸馏策略。这些结果突显了AntiSkillBench作为一个具有挑战性的基准，用于开发保护隐私和注重真实性的角色技能。

articles.title: VetScore: Risk-Weighted Fact Verification for Veterinary Long-Form QA with Citations
articles.abstract: Citation excerpts can be used to increase the reliability of generated outputs and their faithfulness to cited sources, which is especially important in high-stakes domains such as human and veterinary medicine. However, this does not guarantee that generated claims are faithful to the provided excerpts. We present VetScore, a multi-step evaluation method for veterinary long-form question answering, designed to assess how well are generated claims supported by the provided excerpts, weighing this information by each claim's harm potential. VetScore first segments the output and decomposes it into individual claims, then scores each claim with respect to its harm potential and evaluates its faithfulness to source excerpts, and finally calculates the overall risk-adjusted score. We collect an expert-annotated meta-evaluation dataset, evaluate our approach with a range of judge models, and show that it achieves high correlations with veterinary experts even with small judge models, while offering explainability across multiple dimensions.
articles.titleCn: VetScore：用于兽医长文本问答的带引用的风险加权事实核查
articles.abstractCn: 引用摘录可用于提高生成输出的可靠性和其与所引来源的忠实度，这在人类医学和兽医学等高风险领域尤为重要。然而，这并不能保证生成的声明与提供的摘录保持忠实。我们提出了VetScore，这是一种用于兽医长文本问答的多步评估方法，旨在评估生成声明如何得到所提供摘录的支持，并根据每个声明的潜在危害性权衡这些信息。VetScore首先将输出分割并分解为单个声明，然后根据每个声明的潜在危害性对其进行评分，并评估其与来源摘录的忠实度，最后计算整体风险调整得分。我们收集了一个专家标注的元评估数据集，使用多种裁判模型评估我们的方法，并表明即使使用小型裁判模型，该方法与兽医专家也实现了高度相关性，同时在多个维度上提供了可解释性。

articles.title: How Closely Do LLM Reviews Align with Human Peer Review?
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate scientific reviews, yet existing evaluations rarely examine whether different providers align with both conference decisions and human reviewing priorities within the same controlled setting. We compare reviews from OpenAI GPT-5.4, Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, and Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6 with human reviews and final decisions for 300 topic-matched ICLR 2026 submissions, equally divided among oral, poster, and rejected papers. Each model reviewed every paper using identical instructions and rating scales after decision information was removed. Our study contributes a cross-provider analysis of three complementary dimensions: alignment with broad and fine-grained decision categories, differences in recommendation-scale usage, and thematic agreement in identified weaknesses. All three LLMs distinguished accepted from rejected papers, but none reproduced the oral versus poster distinction present in human ratings. Scoring patterns were provider-specific: Gemini assigned systematically higher ratings, while OpenAI and Claude were closer to humans for rejected and poster papers but more critical of oral papers. Human and LLM reviews also differed in emphasis, with LLMs more frequently identifying missing baseline comparisons and humans more often raising computational-efficiency concerns. These results show that broad decision alignment does not imply agreement with finer human judgments or reviewing priorities.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型评论与人类同行评审的一致性有多高？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于生成科学综述，然而现有的评估很少在相同的受控环境下检验不同供应商是否与会议决策和人类评审优先事项保持一致。我们比较了OpenAI GPT-5.4、Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview和Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6生成的综述与300篇主题匹配的ICLR 2026提交论文的人类评审和最终决策，这些论文在口头报告、海报和被拒论文中均等分配。在移除决策信息后，每个模型都使用相同的指令和评分量表对每篇论文进行评审。我们的研究从三个互补维度对跨供应商进行了分析：与广泛和细粒度决策类别的符合度、推荐量表使用差异以及识别出的弱点的主题一致性。所有三个LLM都能区分接受和被拒的论文，但均未复制人类评分中存在的口头报告与海报的区别。评分模式具有供应商特异性：Gemini系统地给出了更高的评分，而OpenAI和Claude在评分被拒和海报论文时更接近人类，但在口头报告论文上更为苛刻。人类和LLM评审在侧重点上也有差异，LLM更频繁地识别出缺失的基线比较，而人类更常提出计算效率问题。这些结果表明，广泛的决策符合度并不等同于与更精细的人类判断或评审优先事项的一致。

articles.title: Decoupling Generation and Selection for Budget-Constrained Faithful Summarization
articles.abstract: Abstractive summarization models remain vulnerable to factual inconsistency, redundancy, and weak length control. We propose a modular generation-and-selection framework for sentence-budget-constrained summarization. A pretrained generator produces multiple candidate summaries, which are decomposed into sentence-level candidates. A combinatorial selector then constructs the final summary by balancing relevance, factuality, and redundancy under an explicit budget. The framework supports MMR, ILP, and a DPP-inspired log-determinant objective without retraining the generator. Experiments on CNN/DailyMail, Multi-News, FaithBench, and TofuEval show consistent improvements in factuality and source-grounding metrics, especially for multi-document summarization, at the cost of lower reference-overlap scores. Human evaluation further indicates higher perceived consistency, relevance, clarity, and conciseness, with a small reduction in coherence. These results show that decoupling generation from selection provides a model-agnostic mechanism for improving factual grounding. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/bcfs-D05E/.
articles.titleCn: 预算约束下忠实摘要的生成与选择解耦
articles.abstractCn: 抽取式摘要模型仍然容易受到事实不一致性、冗余和长度控制不足的影响。我们提出了一种用于句子预算约束摘要的模块化生成与选择框架。预训练的生成器产生多个候选摘要，这些候选摘要被分解为句子级别的候选。组合式选择器随后在明确的预算下，通过平衡相关性、事实性和冗余来构建最终摘要。该框架无需重新训练生成器，即可支持MMR、ILP和受DPP启发的对数行列式目标。在CNN/DailyMail、Multi-News、FaithBench和TofuEval上的实验表明，在事实性和来源关联指标上取得了持续改进，尤其是在多文档摘要方面，代价是参考重叠分数的降低。人工评估进一步表明，感知一致性、相关性、清晰性和简洁性更高，但连贯性略有下降。这些结果表明，将生成与选择解耦为一种模型无关的机制，可以改善事实关联性。代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/bcfs-D05E/获取。

articles.title: LoopMTP: A looped transformer guided by latent multi-token prediction
articles.abstract: Looped transformers have emerged as a parameter-efficient alternative to scaling depth for strong reasoning. By reusing one stack of layers across $T$ iterations, they attain the effective depth and reasoning capabilities of larger models at a fixed parameter count. Yet existing approaches suffer from latent overthinking and undifferentiated computation, largely because intermediate representations receive no guidance across loops. Multi-token prediction (MTP) supplies exactly the dense, forward-looking supervision the loop is missing. We propose \textsc{LoopMTP}, which links the two through a structural correspondence in latent space: a model that loops $T$ times can anticipate $T$ future tokens. \textsc{LoopMTP} realizes this by softly aligning the hidden state of loop $t$ with the embedding of the token $t$ steps ahead, while a lightweight gate preserves useful information across iterations. \textsc{LoopMTP} improves average accuracy by up to 8.1\% (relative) over the non-looped baseline, with training remaining stable for up to 15 loops.
articles.titleCn: LoopMTP：一个由潜在多标记预测引导的循环Transformer
articles.abstractCn: 循环Transformer已成为通过扩展深度来实现强推理的参数高效替代方案。通过在$T$次迭代中重复使用同一堆叠的层，它们在固定参数数量下获得了更大模型的等效深度和推理能力。然而，现有方法存在潜在过度思考和未区分计算的问题，这主要是因为循环中的中间表示没有跨循环的指导。多标记预测（MTP）为循环提供了所缺失的密集、前瞻性指导。我们提出了\textsc{LoopMTP}，通过潜在空间中的结构对应关系将两者联系起来：一个循环$T$次的模型可以预见$T$个未来的标记。\textsc{LoopMTP}通过将循环$t$的隐藏状态与$t$步 ahead 的标记嵌入进行软对齐来实现这一点，同时一个轻量级门保持信息在迭代之间的传递。\textsc{LoopMTP}将平均准确率提高了高达8.1%（相对值），且在高达15次循环的情况下训练保持稳定。

articles.title: A machine-readable catalogue of the Tsiolkovsky papers (fond 555, Archive of the Russian Academy of Sciences), and a way to measure how well its handwriting can be read
articles.abstract: The personal archive of Konstantin Tsiolkovsky (1857-1935) is held as fond 555 of the Archive of the Russian Academy of Sciences. The archive scanned the fond and published the images, but with no queryable catalogue, no full-text search and no dataset: the holdings can only be browsed one page at a time. This paper describes a machine-readable catalogue of all 2,019 files and 51,008 scans, a dating for 1,969 files taken from the archive's own descriptions, a page-level classification of every scan into handwriting and typescript, and a growing corpus of machine transcriptions (currently 322 files, 5,454 scans). It also reports a way to measure handwritten-text-recognition accuracy in an archive with no ground truth. Archives of the typewriter era often preserve one text twice, as manuscript and as a typed copy; transcribing both and comparing isolates the reading error, since source and pipeline are identical and only page difficulty differs. Across 294 such pairs from 27 files, two readings of a handwritten page agree on a median 37% of words. On two files that also have a published edition the estimate can be checked against ground truth: it is unbiased to within a percentage point and ranks pages as the truth does (rank correlation 0.92 where the edition is a faithful witness). This bounds use: two variants of one work here share 19% of words, below the rate at which two readings of a single page agree, so the redactions cannot be collated word by word at this quality. That negative result is reported as such, and the constraint is built into the tool.

articles.titleCn: 一份托尔斯科伊文献的机器可读目录（555号档案，俄罗斯科学院档案馆），以及一种衡量其手稿可读性程度的方法
articles.abstractCn: 康斯坦丁·齐奥尔科夫斯基（1857-1935）的个人档案被保存在俄罗斯科学院档案馆，编号为 fond 555。该档案馆已扫描该档案并发布图像，但缺乏可查询的目录、全文检索功能和数据集：馆藏只能逐页浏览。本文描述了全部2,019份文件和51,008次扫描的机器可读目录，基于档案馆自身描述对1,969份文件进行日期标注，将每份扫描按手写和打字稿进行页面级分类，并逐步积累机器转录文本（目前包含322份文件、5,454次扫描）。此外，本文还介绍了一种在缺乏真实文本的情况下测量手写文本识别准确性的方法。打字机时代的档案通常保存同一文本两次，一次为手稿，一次为打印稿；转录两者并进行比较可以分离阅读错误，因为源文本和转录流程相同，仅页面难度不同。在27份文件中的294对这类文本中，手写页面的两种转录版本在词语上中位数为37%一致。对于另外两份同时有出版版本的文件，可以与真实文本进行验证：其估计结果在百分比上无偏差，且页面排序与真实文本一致（当出版版本忠实反映原始文本时，排序相关系数为0.92）。这一结果限制了使用范围：此处同一作品的两个版本共享19%的词语，低于单页两种转录版本的一致率，因此无法逐词校对修订内容。该负面结果被如实报告，并已将此限制条件纳入工具设计中。

articles.title: Language-Specialized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Multilingual LLM-Based ASR
articles.abstract: Modern LLM-based ASR systems have established multilingual capability as a standard feature, leveraging large-scale multilingual corpora and LLMs' cross-lingual knowledge to achieve competitive performance across multilingual benchmarks. However, jointly modeling languages with heterogeneous acoustic, phonological, and lexical characteristics inevitably introduces optimization conflicts, undermining language-wise specialization. To address this challenge, we propose Language-Specialized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (LS-MOPD), which decouples language-specific knowledge acquisition from multilingual capability integration: language-specialized teachers are independently optimized via reinforcement learning (RL), with their expertise then integrated into a generalist multilingual student through language routing and token-level multi-teacher distillation, thereby reducing direct cross-lingual optimization conflicts. We further explore static and dynamic acoustic-prefix configurations to examine how teacher-student prefix consistency influences the efficacy of on-policy distillation. Experiments on benchmarks covering Mandarin, Mandarin subdialects, Cantonese, and English demonstrate that LS-MOPD substantially outperforms RL baselines and surpasses the empirical performance envelope defined by the best-performing RL teachers on nearly all benchmarks, revealing its potential to generalize beyond all teachers in multilingual ASR.
articles.titleCn: 面向语言的专有教师在线策略蒸馏用于多语言基于LLM的语音识别
articles.abstractCn: 现代基于大语言模型的语音识别系统已将多语言能力作为标准功能，利用大规模多语言语料库和跨语言知识，在多语言基准测试中实现了具有竞争力的性能。然而，联合建模具有异质性声学、音系和词汇特征的语言，不可避免地会引入优化冲突，削弱语言专用性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了语言专用多导师在线蒸馏（LS-MOPD）方法，将语言特定知识获取与多语言能力集成解耦：语言专用导师通过强化学习独立优化，其专业知识随后通过语言路由和token级多导师蒸馏集成到通用型多语言学生中，从而减少直接的跨语言优化冲突。我们进一步探索了静态和动态声学前缀配置，以检验导师-学生前缀一致性如何影响在线蒸馏的有效性。在涵盖普通话、普通话方言、粤语和英语的基准测试上的实验表明，LS-MOPD显著优于强化学习基线，并在几乎所有基准测试上超越了表现最佳的强化学习导师所定义的经验性能边界，揭示了其在多语言语音识别中超越所有导师的泛化潜力。

articles.title: Disentangling Language Modeling and Boundaries
articles.abstract: Byte-level language models are usually argued for on the grounds of robustness, multilingual fairness, and character-level skills. We point to a different, structural advantage: because they read and write bytes, any two of them share an output space, so knowledge transfer between them is exact and independent of how either was originally tokenized. We hypothesize that the two distributions a byte-level model produces, one over the next byte, one over where its patch boundaries fall, can be disentangled and changed almost independently. A model could absorb a teacher's capability while keeping its own boundaries, or change how it places those boundaries while keeping its capabilities. We lay out the two experiments that would settle the hypothesis, alongside preliminary measurements of the properties they rest on. We argue that the community should move toward a byte-level interface as a shared standard: if the hypothesis holds, then once byte-level models are the norm, transferring capabilities and reshaping boundaries between them become cheap and routine, free of the per-model tokenizer that blocks them today.
articles.titleCn: 解耦语言建模与边界
articles.abstractCn: 基于字节的语言模型通常被认为具有鲁棒性、多语言公平性和字符级能力等优点。我们指出其具有不同的结构性优势：由于它们读写字节，任何两个模型共享输出空间，因此它们之间的知识迁移是精确的，且与各自的原始分词方式无关。我们假设字节级模型产生的两个分布——一个关于下一个字节，一个关于其补丁边界的位置——可以被解耦且几乎独立地改变。模型可以在保持自身边界的同时吸收教师的能力，或者在保持能力的同时改变其边界位置。我们阐述了将验证该假设的两个实验，并提供了它们所依赖的初步测量结果。我们主张社区应转向以字节级接口作为共享标准：如果假设成立，那么一旦字节级模型成为常态，它们之间迁移能力和重塑边界将变得廉价且常规，无需当前阻碍它们的模型级分词器。

articles.title: Looking under the Wrong Lamppost: On the Limitations of Automated Translation Quality Estimation
articles.abstract: Automation of Translation Quality Estimation (QE) has emerged as a widely discussed approach to managing translation quality at scale, and a growing number of tools and technologies have been released in pursuit of this goal. However, the proliferation of new QE systems has not always been accompanied by robust, transparent, and reproducible research and testing. This gap deserves critical scrutiny. This paper examines some fundamental limitations of the QE technology from both theoretical and empirical perspectives, arguing that current QE systems are structurally ill-equipped to serve as reliable standalone tools in real-world translation workflows. The reviewed evidence suggests that QE suffers from a range of interrelated and largely unresolved limitations. Most fundamentally, the evaluation of the quality of translation at the level of isolated segments is problematic because it tends to miss out on cohesion, coherence, and stylistic and rhetorical text features. In addition, empirical research documents several other limitations and flaws, including failure to generalize, systematic biases, overfitting and distribution collapse, performance gaps, error annotation challenges, and data scarcity. These are structural limitations arising from the complexity of human language and translation as a cognitive and communicative act - limitations that more data and better architectures have so far not overcome. Consequently, segment-level QE scores should not be used as a standalone basis for routing, release, or review bypass in production; we argue future work should focus on automating human evaluation grounded in MQM.

articles.titleCn: 在错误的灯柱下寻找：关于自动化翻译质量评估的局限性
articles.abstractCn: 翻译质量评估（QE）自动化已成为大规模管理翻译质量的一种广泛讨论的方法，并且越来越多工具和技术被推出以实现这一目标。然而，新QE系统的激增并不总是伴随着稳健、透明和可复现的研究和测试。这一差距值得批判性审视。本文从理论和实证角度考察了QE技术的一些基本局限性，认为当前的QE系统在结构上无法作为可靠的单机工具应用于实际翻译工作流程。所审查的证据表明QE存在一系列相互关联且尚未解决的局限性。最根本的是，在孤立片段层面评估翻译质量存在问题，因为它往往忽略了文本的连贯性、一致性以及风格和修辞特征。此外，实证研究记录了其他几项局限性和缺陷，包括泛化失败、系统性偏差、过拟合和分布崩溃、性能差距、错误标注挑战和数据匮乏。这些是源于人类语言复杂性和翻译作为认知和交际行为的结构性局限——这些局限性迄今为止尚未被更多数据和更好的架构所克服。因此，片段级别的QE分数不应作为生产中路由、发布或审查绕过的独立依据；我们主张未来的工作应专注于基于MQM自动化人工评估。

articles.title: SFT Conflicts, RL Coexists: A Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Multi-Task Learning for LLMs
articles.abstract: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) exhibit fundamentally different behaviors in enhancing multi-task reasoning for large language models (LLMs). Our preliminary experiments revealed a phenomenon: SFT suffers from severe task conflicts under multi-stage training, whereas RL enables stable coexistence across diverse tasks. Empirically, we trace this to the parameter level, observing that RL induces sparse and approximately orthogonal updates across tasks. We provide a theoretical explanation for this mechanism by analyzing multi-task gradient interference. Our results reveal a distinction: interference in SFT is norm-limited, scaling with the absolute gradient magnitude, whereas interference in RL is variance-limited, bounded by the gradient variance induced by advantage normalization and on-policy optimization. This small variance bound yields near-orthogonal optimization directions across tasks. Leveraging this insight, we propose Parallel-RL, a paradigm that decouples multi-task training, significantly improving efficiency and flexibility.
articles.titleCn: SFT冲突，RL共存：针对LLM多任务学习的理论与实证分析
articles.abstractCn: 监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）在增强大型语言模型（LLM）的多任务推理能力方面表现出根本不同的行为。我们的初步实验揭示了一种现象：SFT在多阶段训练中受到严重的任务冲突影响，而RL则能实现不同任务间的稳定共存。从参数层面来看，我们观察到RL能在不同任务间诱导稀疏且近似正交的更新。我们通过分析多任务梯度干扰为这一机制提供了理论解释。我们的结果表明，SFT中的干扰受范数限制，与梯度绝对值成正比，而RL中的干扰受方差限制，由优势归一化和策略优化诱导的梯度方差所界定。这种小的方差界限使得任务间的优化方向近似正交。基于这一见解，我们提出了Parallel-RL范式，该范式解耦了多任务训练，显著提升了效率和灵活性。

articles.title: Hi-TTRL: Regulating Consensus with Hints for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models without labeled data by updating the policy with pseudo-labels constructed through majority voting. While effective, the reward signal assigned from majority voting is highly sensitive to consensus strength, defined as the frequency of the most common answer within a rollout group. In TTRL, consensus strength plays a dual role: it reflects both the reliability of the pseudo-label and the distribution of advantages. Low consensus can amplify updates from unreliable pseudo-labels through disproportionately large advantages, whereas high consensus reduces reward contrast and ultimately yields vanishing gradients. In this paper, we introduce Hi-TTRL, a test-time reinforcement learning framework that utilizes hints during sampling to regulate rollout consensus strength. Hi-TTRL first estimates consensus strength from a partial rollout group. When the consensus strength falls outside a target interval, it invokes a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) hint sampler. The sampler targets the power-transformed prefix distribution and uses finite-step approximate sampling to generate rollout prefixes as hints. By tuning the power exponent, Hi-TTRL generates hints with a sharpened or flattened power target, steering rollout consensus strength toward the target interval. Experiments on multiple datasets and backbones show that Hi-TTRL consistently improves over standard TTRL, with ablations and consensus-steering analyses validating the effectiveness of adaptive hint-guided consensus regulation.
articles.titleCn: Hi-TTRL：通过提示调节共识的测试时强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 测试时强化学习（TTRL）通过使用多数投票构建的伪标签更新策略，在不依赖标注数据的情况下提升了大型语言模型的推理能力。尽管有效，多数投票分配的奖励信号对共识强度高度敏感，共识强度定义为在展开组内最常见答案的频率。在TTRL中，共识强度具有双重作用：它既反映了伪标签的可靠性，也反映了优势的分布。低共识会通过不成比例的大优势放大来自不可靠伪标签的更新，而高共识会降低奖励对比度，最终导致梯度消失。在本文中，我们引入了Hi-TTRL，这是一个利用采样过程中的提示来调节展开组共识强度的测试时强化学习框架。Hi-TTRL首先从部分展开组估计共识强度。当共识强度超出目标区间时，它会调用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）提示采样器。采样器针对幂变换的前缀分布，并使用有限步近似采样来生成作为提示的展开组前缀。通过调整幂指数，Hi-TTRL生成具有锐化或扁平化幂目标的提示，引导展开组共识强度朝向目标区间。在多个数据集和主干网络上的实验表明，Hi-TTRL始终优于标准TTRL，消融实验和共识引导分析验证了自适应提示引导共识调节的有效性。

articles.title: Cross-Lingual Bias in Large Language Models: A Comparative Analysis of English and Swahili
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in multilingual contexts, yet safety alignment and bias evaluation remain overwhelmingly English-centric. We investigate whether social biases generalise across languages by submitting 4,900 symmetric English--Swahili prompt pairs to GPT-5.2 and Gemini 2.5 Flash across nine demographic bias axes, yielding 19,600 completions evaluated for stereotype prevalence, sentiment, refusal behaviour, and cross-lingual semantic similarity. Our findings show that bias transforms rather than transfers: stereotype rates shifted by up to 12 percentage points on specific axes, Gemini's neutral-sentiment rate doubled in Swahili, and GPT-5.2 refused 169 prompts in English and zero in Swahili, consistent with refusal behaviour anchored to English-language surface forms at the behavioural level. Over 55% of prompt pairs produced semantically dissimilar completions across both models. These reinforce the idea that English-only bias audits do not produce adequate coverage for multilingual deployment.
articles.titleCn: 跨语言偏差在大语言模型中的比较分析：英语与斯瓦希里语
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正越来越多地应用于多语言环境，但安全对齐和偏见评估仍高度依赖英语。我们通过向GPT-5.2和Gemini 2.5 Flash提交4,900组对称的英语-斯瓦希里提示对，在九个人口统计偏见轴上测试社会偏见是否能在语言间泛化，并获得了19,600个完成结果，用于评估刻板印象的普遍性、情感倾向、拒绝行为以及跨语言语义相似度。我们的研究发现偏见是转化而非转移：在特定轴上刻板印象率变化高达12个百分点，Gemini在斯瓦希里中的中性情感率翻倍，GPT-5.2在英语中拒绝169个提示而在斯瓦希里中一个也未拒绝，这与拒绝行为在行为层面锚定于英语语言表层形式一致。超过55%的提示对在两个模型中产生了语义不相似的完成结果。这些发现进一步证实，仅针对英语的偏见审计并不足以覆盖多语言部署。

articles.title: Consensus Measures for Unstructured Biomedical Text Annotations
articles.abstract: Biomedical literature is increasingly mined for knowledge beyond the questions it was written to answer. Because the target concepts are not known in advance, annotators prefer open-ended labels, whose agreement is hard to quantify. We study soft inter-rater reliability for annotators providing unstructured texts for biomedical annotation tasks. Synthetic experiments show that soft reliability can be quantified using a variety of semantic equivalence measures, and that the choice of measure affects failure modes of the estimation. Embeddings are scalable, but limited when differentiating similar but distinct concepts. Large language models are promising, but limited by scalability for estimating agreement by chance. Finally, we suggest measures based on natural language inference as a sensible compromise.
articles.titleCn: 非结构化生物医学文本标注的共识度量
articles.abstractCn: 生物医学文献正越来越多地被挖掘，以获取其写作时未涉及的知识。由于目标概念事先未知，标注者倾向于使用开放式标签，而这类标签的一致性难以量化。我们研究了为生物医学标注任务提供非结构化文本的标注者的软互评可靠性。合成实验表明，软可靠性可以使用多种语义等价度量方法进行量化，并且度量方法的选择会影响估计的失效模式。嵌入方法具有可扩展性，但在区分相似但不同的概念时存在局限性。大型语言模型前景广阔，但受限于通过随机估计一致性时的可扩展性。最后，我们建议基于自然语言推理的度量方法作为一种合理的折衷方案。

articles.title: Training Documents Reranker with Search Rubrics for Deep Research Agent
articles.abstract: Retrieval systems help deep research agents generate high-quality answers by providing relevant documents. However, existing retrievers typically select documents through relevance matching, while individually well-matched top-$k$ documents may not form a \textit{set} that satisfies the complex information needs of an agent query (\eg, diverse, concise and authoritative documents). In this paper, we propose search-oriented rubrics that \textit{explicitly} define the requirements that high-quality document sets should satisfy for each agent query. Our search rubrics are organized into a hierarchical structure and synthesized using a powerful LLM. Based on these search rubrics, we further train a document reranker \textbf{RubricRanker} to select a high-quality subset from retrieved documents. We design a two-stage training framework that consists of rubrics-guided supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RubricRanker outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.6 points on four deep research benchmarks and generalizes well to five RAG benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 使用搜索标准对深度研究代理的培训文档重新排序器进行训练
articles.abstractCn: 检索系统通过提供相关文档帮助深度研究智能体生成高质量答案。然而，现有的检索器通常通过相关性匹配来选择文档，而单独匹配良好的前k文档可能无法形成一个满足智能体查询复杂信息需求的文档集合（例如，多样化、简洁且权威的文档）。在本文中，我们提出了面向搜索的评分标准，明确定义了高质量文档集合应满足的每个智能体查询要求。我们的搜索评分标准被组织成一个分层结构，并使用强大的大型语言模型进行综合。基于这些搜索评分标准，我们进一步训练了一个文档重排序器RubricRanker，从检索到的文档中选择高质量子集。我们设计了一个两阶段训练框架，包括评分标准引导的监督微调和基于评分标准的强化学习。大量实验表明，RubricRanker在四个深度研究基准上比最强的基线提高了2.6分，并且很好地泛化到了五个RAG基准。

articles.title: ChronoLens: Measuring Language Change Across Time, Languages, and Linguistic Levels
articles.abstract: Historical language change affects morphology, syntax, semantics, and pragmatics, yet computational studies typically examine these levels with incompatible representations and therefore cannot determine whether they evolve together across languages. We address this problem by asking how the magnitude and direction of change vary across linguistic levels, languages, and historical periods within a single analytical space. We introduce ChronoLens, a framework that combines frozen multilingual language models, feature-aligned crosscoders, and post-hoc linguistic interventions, and apply it to 44.98 million documents and approximately 17.2 billion tokens from five parliamentary traditions spanning 1803--2026. The resulting sparse representations agree substantially more strongly with linguistic statistics than dense embeddings or a pooled sparse autoencoder ($ρ=0.72$ versus $0.29$ and $0.28$), and reveal that morphology, syntax, semantics, and pragmatics generally change by comparable amounts within a language, while languages differ markedly in when, how far, and in which direction they change. These findings show that historical language change is a structured, multidimensional process: similar magnitudes can conceal different trajectories, and meaningful cross-linguistic comparison requires measuring both distance and direction.
articles.titleCn: ChronoLens：测量语言随时间、语言和语言层级的变化
articles.abstractCn: 历史语言变化影响形态、句法、语义和语用，但计算研究通常用不相容的表示方法来考察这些层面，因此无法确定它们是否在不同语言中共同演变。我们通过探究在单一分析空间内，变化幅度和方向如何在不同语言层面、语言和历史时期之间变化来解决这个问题。我们引入了ChronoLens框架，该框架结合了冻结的多语言语言模型、特征对齐的跨编码器和事后语言学干预，并将其应用于涵盖1803年至2026年的五个议会传统中的4498万份文档和约1720亿个标记。所得的稀疏表示与语言统计数据相比，密集嵌入或池化稀疏自编码器（ρ=0.72与0.29和0.28）的吻合程度显著更高，并揭示出在单一语言中，形态、句法、语义和语用通常以相当的幅度变化，而不同语言在变化的时间、程度和方向上存在显著差异。这些发现表明，历史语言变化是一个结构化、多维度的过程：相似的幅度可能掩盖不同的轨迹，而具有意义的跨语言比较需要同时测量距离和方向。

articles.title: ConlangBench: Exploring Language Knowledge and Learning in LLMs through Diverse Constructed Languages
articles.abstract: Constructed languages (conlangs) are intentionally created human languages with a rich tradition of linguistic creativity. Despite their potential for studying language learning in large language models (LLMs), existing conlangs remain largely underexplored in LLM research. We present ConlangBench, the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating and training LLMs on 21 existing conlangs. We collect over 21M conlang-English parallel sentence pairs (including 430K pairs across the 20 non-Esperanto conlangs) and 321K vocabulary entries. In bidirectional translation experiments, we find that models perform better on a posteriori conlangs, whose vocabularies are derived from natural languages, reflecting the design characteristics of conlangs. Training on ConlangBench also shows that models can learn all eight conlangs for which sufficient parallel corpora are available, while their learning curves vary depending on how the conlangs were created. Our findings suggest that conlangs provide a unique testbed for investigating how LLMs acquire low-resource languages.
articles.titleCn: ConlangBench：通过多种人工语言探索大型语言模型中的语言知识和学习
articles.abstractCn: 构建语言（conlangs）是人类有意创造的具有丰富语言创造传统的语言。尽管它们在研究大型语言模型（LLMs）中的语言学习潜力巨大，但现有的构建语言在LLM研究中仍基本未被探索。我们提出了ConlangBench，这是首个用于评估和训练LLMs在21种现有构建语言上的大规模基准。我们收集了超过2100万对构建语言-英语平行句子（包括20种非世界语构建语言中的43万对）和321万个词汇条目。在双向翻译实验中，我们发现模型在后验构建语言上表现更好，这些语言的词汇源自自然语言，反映了构建语言的设计特征。在ConlangBench上的训练也表明，模型能够学习所有有足够平行语料库的八种构建语言，而它们的学习曲线则因构建语言的方式不同而有所差异。我们的研究结果表明，构建语言为研究LLMs如何习得低资源语言提供了一个独特的试验平台。

articles.title: Learning Sexism Detection Using Multi-Agent Perspectivist Preference Optimization
articles.abstract: When people label text for sexism, they often disagree, and not because some of them are wrong: they genuinely perceive sexism differently. Most NLP systems discard this disagreement by collapsing it into a majority vote. We propose the Multi-Agent Perspectivist Preference Optimization (MAP-PO) framework to keep these different perspectives. On the EXIST 2024 dataset of labeled English and Spanish tweets, we first cluster annotators by their labeling behavior rather than their demographic attributes. We then fine-tune one Large Language Model agent per cluster to reproduce that cluster's annotation behavior, and coordinate the agents with preference optimization that combines individual and team-level rewards. We evaluate MAP-PO in four settings defined by two languages and two backbone language models, asking whether each agent reproduces the annotations of its own cluster and whether the agents together reproduce the majority label. Two findings hold in all four settings. First, without fine-tuning the agents behave almost identically, so cluster-specific training is necessary. Second, we show that training each agent only on the labels of its own cluster pushes the agents far beyond the clusters they should represent, while adding a shared team-level training signal consistently keeps each agent calibrated to its cluster.
articles.comment: 17 pages, 12 figures, 14 tables. Preprint; under review at EACL 2027 (ACL Rolling Review, August 2026 cycle). Code and data: https://github.com/mohammadi-hadi/MAP-PO
articles.titleCn: 基于多智能体视角偏好优化学习性别歧视检测
articles.abstractCn: 当人们为文本标记性别歧视时，他们常常意见不一，这并非因为其中一些人判断错误：他们确实以不同的方式感知性别歧视。大多数自然语言处理系统通过将其简化为多数投票来忽略这种分歧。我们提出了多智能体视角偏好优化（MAP-PO）框架来保留这些不同的视角。在EXIST 2024数据集上，我们首先根据标注行为而非人口统计属性对标注者进行聚类。然后，我们对每个聚类的单个大型语言模型智能体进行微调，以复制该聚类的标注行为，并通过结合个人和团队层面的奖励的偏好优化来协调这些智能体。我们在由两种语言和两种骨干语言模型定义的四个设置中评估了MAP-PO，询问每个智能体是否复制了其所属聚类的标注，以及这些智能体是否共同复制了多数标签。在所有四个设置中，有两个发现是成立的。首先，未经微调的智能体几乎行为完全相同，因此需要针对特定聚类进行训练。其次，我们证明，仅使用其所属聚类的标签来训练每个智能体会使其远远超出其应有的代表性，而添加共享的团队层面训练信号始终能确保每个智能体与其所属聚类保持校准。

articles.title: Beyond Initialization Loss: A Systematic Study of Token Embedding Initialization Strategies for LLM Vocabulary Extension
articles.abstract: Vocabulary extension is an efficient way to adapt pretrained large language models (LLMs) to new languages, but the initialization of newly added token embeddings can strongly affect continued pre-training (CPT) efficiency. We present a systematic study of more than 20 initialization strategies for Hindi vocabulary extension in Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B. Our comparison spans vocabulary-averaging baselines; external and learned initialization methods, including FOCUS, top-k semantic retrieval, and residual MLP mappings; subword composition; norm calibration; and input-output asymmetry. We find that subword composition methods outperform both vocabulary averaging and external/learned initialization approaches. Within subword composition, asymmetric variants achieve the lowest observed early validation loss and reveal distinct preferences for input and output embedding initialization. The best observed configuration initializes the input embedding matrix with uniform subword averaging and Hindi-specific norm calibration, and the output language modeling head with character-length-weighted subword averaging. Relative to the standard Mean-all baseline, this full initialization pipeline reaches comparable validation loss with over a 6x reduction in CPT steps and exceeds the baseline's 3,500-step MILU-Hindi accuracy after only 500 steps. Finally, we show that initialization loss and initialization bits-per-byte (Init BPB) are unreliable predictors of downstream convergence, whereas lightweight CPT, as few as 50 steps, provides a cost-effective and reliable signal for selecting the best initialization strategy.
articles.titleCn: 超越初始化损失：对LLM词汇扩展中标记嵌入初始化策略的系统研究
articles.abstractCn: 词汇扩展是使预训练的大型语言模型（LLM）适应新语言的有效方法，但新添加的词嵌入的初始化会显著影响持续预训练（CPT）的效率。我们对Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B中印地语词汇扩展的20多种初始化策略进行了系统研究。我们的比较涵盖了词汇平均基线；外部和学习的初始化方法，包括FOCUS、top-k语义检索和残差MLP映射；子词组合；范数校准；以及输入输出不对称性。我们发现子词组合方法优于词汇平均和外部/学习初始化方法。在子词组合中，非对称变体实现了观察到的最低早期验证损失，并显示出对输入和输出嵌入初始化的不同偏好。最佳配置是使用均匀子词平均初始化输入嵌入矩阵，并进行印地语特定范数校准，同时使用字符长度加权子词平均初始化输出语言建模头。与标准Mean-all基线相比，这种完整初始化流程在CPT步骤减少6倍的情况下达到了相当的验证损失，并且在仅进行500步后，其3,500步的MILU-Hindi准确率超过了基线。最后，我们证明初始化损失和初始化每字节位数（Init BPB）是不可靠的下游收敛预测指标，而轻量级CPT（仅50步）提供了选择最佳初始化策略的成本效益和可靠信号。

articles.title: Efficient Multilingual Neural Machine Translation via Corpus-Driven Vocabulary Pruning: An English-Arabic Case Study
articles.abstract: The adoption of large pre-trained multilingual models for neural machine translation (MNMT) faces a major challenge: excessive memory and computational consumption due to overly large vocabularies and embedding layers. Although existing compression methods like pruning, quantization and knowledge distillation reduce parameter redundancy, they mainly preserve the structure of the original vocabulary, thereby leaving a major source of inefficiency unresolved. We propose in this paper a general optimization framework that combines a vocabulary pruning method with a targeted fine-tuning protocol for MNMT models. We evaluate the proposed framework using three models (M2M100, NLLB-200, mBART-50) on the English-Arabic language pair. Our approach reduces the vocabulary size from over 128,000 to approximately 10,000 tokens, enabling a 60% memory saving without any loss in performance. Results show that optimized multilingual models can match or exceed the performance of dedicated bilingual baselines. In particular, the pruned and fine-tuned M2M100 model achieves a competitive BLEU score of 42.04 (against 44.59 for the OPUS-MTen- ar bilingual model) while it significantly outperforms it on the COMET metric (0.8730 vs 0.7911) revealing superior semantic adequacy and fluency.
articles.titleCn: 基于语料库驱动的词汇剪枝的高效多语言神经机器翻译：英阿案例研究
articles.abstractCn: 将大型预训练多语言模型应用于神经机器翻译（MNMT）面临一个主要挑战：由于词汇表过大和嵌入层过于复杂，导致内存和计算消耗过高。尽管现有的压缩方法，如剪枝、量化和知识蒸馏，可以减少参数冗余，但它们主要保留了原始词汇表的结构，从而未能解决效率的主要来源问题。本文提出了一种通用的优化框架，该框架结合了词汇表剪枝方法和针对MNMT模型的定向微调协议。我们使用三种模型（M2M100、NLLB-200、mBART-50）在英语-阿拉伯语语言对上评估了所提出的框架。我们的方法将词汇表大小从超过12.8万个减少到约1万个词元，实现了60%的内存节省，同时没有任何性能损失。结果表明，优化的多语言模型可以匹配或超过专用双语基线的性能。特别是，剪枝和微调后的M2M100模型取得了具有竞争力的BLEU分数42.04（与OPUS-MT-en的双语模型44.59相比），同时在COMET指标上显著优于该模型（0.8730 vs 0.7911），显示出更优越的语义充分性和流畅性。

articles.title: Adaptive Modality Reliability Diagnosis and Restoration for Robust Multimodal Intent Recognition
articles.abstract: Multimodal intent recognition combines linguistic, acoustic, and visual evidence, but individual modalities may be noisy, missing, semantically conflicting, or disproportionately dominant. Existing methods typically infer modality importance implicitly and either reweight or suppress unreliable inputs, without determining whether a degraded modality can be repaired and subsequently trusted. We propose PRIME (Precision-weighted Reliability Inference and Modality rEstoration), a closed-loop reliability guided framework that jointly diagnoses, restores, and reassesses modality quality at the sample level. PRIME represents the weakness of each modality through a contextual log-variance estimated from complementary diagnostic evidence, including predictive confidence, epistemic disagreement, cross-modal consensus, and feature degeneracy. Because modality-reliability annotations are unavailable, the estimator is explicitly trained using controlled modality corruption with known degradation severity, together with a heteroscedastic uncertainty objective. Rather than directly discarding an unreliable modality, PRIME uses its estimated weakness to control a prototype-conditioned variational restoration module that reconstructs the degraded representation from complementary modalities. Crucially, reliability is re-estimated after restoration, allowing the model to determine whether the repaired representation has become sufficiently trustworthy to contribute to prediction. The resulting post-restoration precisions are used for inverse-variance multimodal fusion. Experiments on multimodal intent-recognition benchmarks show that PRIME maintains competitive clean-data performance while improving robustness under missing, noisy, conflicting, and modality-imbalanced conditions.
articles.titleCn: 自适应模态可靠性诊断与恢复，用于鲁棒多模态意图识别
articles.abstractCn: 多模态意图识别结合了语言、声学和视觉证据，但各个模态可能存在噪声、缺失、语义冲突或不均衡主导。现有方法通常隐式推断模态重要性，或重新加权或抑制不可靠的输入，而未判断退化模态是否可以修复并随后信任。我们提出了PRIME（Precision-weighted Reliability Inference and Modality Restoration，精确加权可靠性推断与模态修复），这是一个闭环可靠性引导框架，在样本级别联合诊断、修复和重新评估模态质量。PRIME通过互补诊断证据（包括预测置信度、认知分歧、跨模态共识和特征退化）估计的上下文对数方差来表示每个模态的弱点。由于缺乏模态可靠性标注，估计器使用受控的模态污染（已知退化严重程度）和异方差不确定性目标进行显式训练。PRIME不是直接丢弃不可靠模态，而是利用其估计的弱点来控制原型条件变分修复模块，从互补模态中重建退化表示。关键在于修复后重新估计可靠性，使模型能够判断修复后的表示是否足够可信以用于预测。修复后的精度用于逆方差多模态融合。在多模态意图识别基准测试上的实验表明，PRIME在干净数据条件下保持有竞争力的性能，同时在缺失、噪声、冲突和模态不平衡条件下提高了鲁棒性。

articles.title: ChartAnno: Evaluating MLLMs for Chart Annotation Generation
articles.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in chart understanding, generation, and editing, but their ability to annotate existing charts remains underexplored. Annotating charts is a common yet challenging communicative task, requiring models to infer intended messages, interpret chart semantics, and place appropriate textual or graphical elements. To address this gap, we introduce ChartAnno, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on chart annotation generation. It contains 1,200 real-world charts with paired code and annotation instructions across three levels of instruction specificity. We evaluate 10 representative MLLMs under two primary input settings: (1) chart code alone and (2) both chart code and chart image, and further include a chart image-only ablation study. Results show that proprietary models remain stronger overall, although large-scale open-source models narrow the gap. More specific instructions improve annotation quality, while inferring abstract intent remains most difficult for current MLLMs. Providing chart images brings limited overall gains, with improvements mainly appearing in design-related metrics. These findings highlight chart annotation generation as a challenging task requiring semantic grounding and effective annotation design. Code and data will be released in a future version.
articles.titleCn: ChartAnno：评估用于图表注释生成的多模态大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在图表理解、生成和编辑方面取得了显著进展，但它们在标注现有图表方面的能力仍待探索。标注图表是一项普遍存在但充满挑战的沟通任务，要求模型推断预期信息、解释图表语义，并放置适当的文本或图形元素。为填补这一空白，我们引入了ChartAnno，这是一个用于评估MLLMs在图表标注生成方面的基准。它包含1200个真实世界图表，配有代码和标注说明，分为三个不同指令明确程度的级别。我们评估了10个有代表性的MLLMs，在两种主要输入设置下进行测试：(1) 仅图表代码和(2) 图表代码与图表图像同时提供，并进一步进行了仅图表图像的消融研究。结果表明，专有模型整体上仍然更强，尽管大规模开源模型缩小了差距。更具体的指令能提高标注质量，而推断抽象意图对当前MLLMs来说仍是最具挑战性的。提供图表图像带来的整体收益有限，改进主要体现在与设计相关的指标上。这些发现突显了图表标注生成是一项需要语义基础和有效标注设计的具有挑战性的任务。代码和数据将在未来版本中发布。

articles.title: Modality Agreement- and Conflict-Aware Prototype Hypergraph Learning for Multimodal Intent Understanding
articles.abstract: Multimodal intent recognition requires understanding not only what textual, acoustic, and visual signals share, but also how they disagree. Such disagreement is frequently class-informative; for example, lexical positivity accompanied by incongruent vocal or facial behavior may indicate sarcasm or taunting, yet most fusion methods either encourage modality alignment or treat inconsistency as uncertainty to be suppressed. We propose MACH (Modality Agreement- and Conflict-aware prototype Hypergraph), a hierarchical prototype-hypergraph framework that represents multimodal agreement and conflict as distinct, recurring relational structures. MACH progressively composes unimodal representations into bimodal and trimodal abstractions. At each applicable level, modality-composition anchors activate sparse agreement prototype hypergraphs that capture reusable consensus patterns, while a separate conflict pathway maps cross-modal discrepancies to dedicated conflict prototype hypergraphs. The two pathways are combined through a feature-wise, sample-adaptive arbitration mechanism, enabling the model to preserve informative disagreement while suppressing incidental modality noise. A progressive optimization strategy stabilizes the interdependent hierarchy before joint agreement-conflict learning. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed formulation, while component and robustness analyses validate the distinct roles of hierarchical composition, prototype-mediated semantic refinement, and agreement-conflict arbitration.
articles.titleCn: 模态协议与冲突感知原型超图学习用于多模态意图理解
articles.abstractCn: 多模态意图识别不仅需要理解文本、声学和视觉信号之间的共性，还需要理解它们之间的分歧。这种分歧通常是类别信息丰富的；例如，伴随不一致的语音或面部行为的词汇积极性可能表明讽刺或嘲弄，然而大多数融合方法要么鼓励模态一致性，要么将不一致性视为需要抑制的不确定性。我们提出了MACH（模态一致性与冲突感知原型超图），这是一个分层原型超图框架，将多模态一致性与冲突表示为不同的、重复出现的关联结构。MACH逐步将单模态表示组合成双模态和三模态的抽象。在每个适用层级，模态组合锚激活稀疏一致原型超图，以捕获可重用的共识模式，而一个单独的冲突路径将跨模态差异映射到专门冲突原型超图。这两条路径通过逐特征、逐样本自适应的仲裁机制相结合，使模型能够保留信息丰富的分歧，同时抑制偶然的模态噪声。渐进式优化策略在联合一致性与冲突学习之前稳定了相互依赖的层级结构。在基准数据集上的实验证明了所提出公式的有效性，而组件和鲁棒性分析验证了分层组合、原型介导的语义精炼以及一致性与冲突仲裁的不同作用。

articles.title: Probing Character-level Transformers for the Spanish L-shaped Morphome
articles.abstract: When a transformer learns an irregular morphological pattern, what has it learned? Our test case is the Spanish \emph{L-shaped morphome}, a complex irregular pattern in which the verb's stem alternates in exactly the first-person singular indicative and all subjunctive forms, and whose membership no phonological, semantic, or syntactic feature predicts. Prior studies have shown that character-level transformers can reproduce this pattern, but that evidence describes what models produce, not what they represent. Probing five architectures, twelve trained models each, under lemma-disjoint cross-validation with controls and surface baselines, we show that the models encode the L-shaped class itself, not just its visible alternations. It is decodable above every surface baseline, survives instances in which every form shows the same stem, and probes trained on alternating instances still classify non-alternating ones. The encoding is localized where the stem choice is made, at the stem-final consonant position of the middle decoder, before the alternant is read. And it is item-specific: which verbs a model learned matters far more than which architecture it is. The models store the morphome as an item-specific lexical abstraction, sufficient to reproduce the pattern but not to generalize it as humans do.
articles.titleCn: 针对西班牙L形形态的字符级Transformer探测
articles.abstractCn: 当一个Transformer学习一个不规则的形态学模式时，它学到了什么？我们的测试案例是西班牙语的\emph{L形形态素}，这是一个复杂的、不规则的模式，其中动词的词干在第一人称单数直陈式和所有虚拟式形式中交替变化，而其成员资格无法通过语音学、语义学或句法特征来预测。先前研究表明，字符级别的Transformer可以复制这种模式，但这些证据描述的是模型产生的结果，而不是模型所表征的内容。在 lemma-不 disjoint 交叉验证下，我们对五个架构各训练了十二个模型，并设置了控制和表面基线，结果表明，模型编码的是L形类别本身，而不仅仅是其可见的交替变化。它可以被所有表面基线解码，在所有形式都显示相同词干的情况下依然存在，并且在交替实例上训练的模型仍然可以分类非交替实例。这种编码在词干选择的位置是局部的，位于中间解码器的词干末尾辅音位置，在交替形式被读取之前。而且它是项目特定的：模型学习了哪些动词远比它采用了哪种架构更重要。模型将形态素存储为项目特定的词汇抽象，足以复制该模式，但不能像人类那样泛化。

articles.title: Balancing Efficiency and Efficacy: Training-Free Attention-Guided Switching Between Explicit and Latent Thoughts for MLLMs
articles.abstract: Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) requires both fine-grained visual perception and rigorous logical deduction. Explicit text-based Chain-of-Thought (CoT) is computationally expensive and prone to visual hallucinations, while existing latent reasoning methods typically require costly training. Furthermore, directly adapting training-free LLM reasoning mechanisms to the multimodal setting yields unstable performance. We identify that this failure stems from their reliance on token-level entropy, which fundamentally conflates perceptual ambiguity (e.g., unclear visual details) with logical uncertainty (e.g., complex reasoning steps). To overcome this bottleneck, we present a novel training-free inference strategy for MLLMs that explicitly decouples perception and reasoning. We propose a novel metric, the vision-to-text attention ratio, to dynamically gauge the model's cognitive focus. Guided by this metric, our proposed framework, Attention-Guided Switching (AGS), adaptively triggers latent reasoning for perceptual tokens to preserve high-fidelity visual information in the continuous space, while enforcing explicit text generation for logical tokens to maintain structural anchoring. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly improving both accuracy and inference efficiency by reducing autoregressive steps and latency. Code is released at https://github.com/swordAndSnow/MM26-AGS.

articles.titleCn: 平衡效率与效能：针对MLLMs的无训练注意力引导机制，在显式与潜在思维之间切换
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中的推理需要精细的视觉感知和严谨的逻辑推理。显式的基于文本的思维链（CoT）计算成本高且容易产生视觉幻觉，而现有的潜推理方法通常需要昂贵的训练。此外，将无训练的LLM推理机制直接应用于多模态场景会导致性能不稳定。我们识别出这种失败源于它们依赖于token级别的熵，这从根本上混淆了感知模糊性（例如，不清晰的视觉细节）与逻辑不确定性（例如，复杂的推理步骤）。为了克服这一瓶颈，我们提出了一种针对MLLMs的新型无训练推理策略，该策略明确地将感知和推理解耦。我们提出了一种新的指标——视觉到文本注意力比率，用于动态评估模型的认知焦点。在该指标的指导下，我们提出的框架——注意力引导切换（AGS），自适应地触发潜推理以感知token，以在连续空间中保留高保真视觉信息，同时强制对逻辑token进行显式文本生成以保持结构锚定。大量实验表明，我们的方法达到了最先进的性能，通过减少自回归步骤和延迟，显著提高了准确性和推理效率。代码已发布在https://github.com/swordAndSnow/MM26-AGS。

articles.title: Predicting Multilingual Classification and Translation Performance of LLMs with Cross-Lingual Alignment $\unicode{x2013}$ Is English Enough?
articles.abstract: Multilingual large language models (LLMs) have been shown to perform better on non-English classification tasks when the representations of the given language are more aligned to English within the model. Several cross-lingual alignment (CLA) scores have been proposed for use with LLMs, along with multiple approaches for extracting embeddings from the models. We provide a comparative analysis of 27 CLA score variants, examining how they differ and how well each predicts downstream performance across three tasks. Crucially, while LLMs are widely used for generative tasks such as machine translation, prior work has focused almost exclusively on classification. We therefore investigate whether CLA scores are similarly predictive of translation performance. To enable computing correlations across target languages, we propose a PMI-based translation metric, which is less dependent on the target language and correlates strongly with chrF. We find that CLA with English predicts translation quality comparably to or better than source-target CLA, providing new evidence that LLMs use English as an internal pivot language.
articles.titleCn: 基于跨语言对齐预测多语言分类与翻译性能的LLM $\unicode{x2013}$ 英语足够吗？
articles.abstractCn: 多语言大型语言模型（LLMs）在非英语分类任务上表现更佳，这表明模型中给定语言的表征与英语的匹配度越高，其性能越好。目前已有多种跨语言对齐（CLA）评分方法被提出用于LLMs，并伴随多种从模型中提取嵌入的方法。我们对27种CLA评分变体进行了比较分析，考察了它们的差异以及每种评分在三个任务中对下游性能的预测能力。关键在于，尽管LLMs广泛应用于机器翻译等生成任务，但以往研究几乎只关注分类任务。因此，我们探究了CLA评分是否同样能预测翻译性能。为便于跨目标语言计算相关性，我们提出了一种基于PMI的翻译度量方法，该方法对目标语言依赖性较低，且与chrF高度相关。我们发现，使用英语进行CLA对翻译质量的预测能力，与源语言-目标语言CLA相比相当甚至更好，为LLMs将英语作为内部基准语言提供了新的证据。

articles.title: Dynamically Allocating Evaluation Effort for Model Ranking
articles.abstract: While human evaluation is the gold standard in many NLP tasks, it suffers from prohibitive costs and poor scalability. When identifying top-performing models, typical evaluation protocols waste effort by exhaustively evaluating all models on the entire benchmark, a safe but inefficient approach. In this work, we formalize multi-model human evaluation as a best-arm identification problem in a multi-armed bandit setup with correlated arms, where pulling an arm corresponds to human-evaluating a model. By sampling adaptively based on the intermediate model rankings obtained on the samples so far, we can focus the annotation budget on the most competitive models. We prove the optimality of the proposed algorithms and show that it improves discrimination between top-performing models. This makes evaluations faster, cheaper and more aligned with large-scale competition evaluation goals.
articles.titleCn: 动态分配评估资源用于模型排序
articles.abstractCn: 虽然人工评估在许多自然语言处理任务中是黄金标准，但它存在高昂的成本和较差的可扩展性。在识别表现最佳的模型时，典型的评估协议通过在所有基准测试模型上进行彻底评估来浪费精力，这是一种安全但低效的方法。在这项工作中，我们将多模型人工评估形式化为在具有相关臂的多臂老虎机设置中的最佳臂识别问题，其中拉动一个臂对应于评估一个模型。通过根据到目前为止在样本上获得的中间模型排名进行自适应采样，我们可以将标注预算集中在最具竞争力的模型上。我们证明了所提出算法的最优性，并表明它提高了顶级模型之间的区分度。这使得评估更快、更便宜，并且更符合大规模竞赛评估目标。

articles.title: DUD: Decoupled Update Dynamics for Reliable Uncertainty Quantification in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Accurate Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is critical for reliable deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet traditional probability-based metrics often fail to capture the model's true epistemic state. While recent mechanistic approaches leverage hidden state dynamics, they typically aggregate residual stream updates, conflating the distinct roles of parametric memory (Feed-Forward Networks) and contextual processing (Attention). We argue that this aggregation obscures fine-grained mechanistic conflicts, such as memory-context misalignment, that are fundamental indicators of uncertainty. To address this, we introduce \textbf{D}ecoupled \textbf{U}pdate \textbf{D}ynamics \textbf{(DUD)}, a framework that explicitly decouples FFN and Attention contributions via noise-induced causal interventions. By quantifying the independent restoration capabilities of each module, we construct a dual-stream dynamic profile that captures the model's internal fragility. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DUD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both uncertainty estimation and calibration, while exhibiting superior cross-dataset generalization, validating decoupled dynamics as a robust proxy for model faithfulness.
articles.titleCn: DUD：用于大型语言模型可靠不确定性量化的解耦更新动态
articles.abstractCn: 精确的不确定性量化（UQ）对于大型语言模型（LLMs）的可靠部署至关重要，然而传统的基于概率的指标往往无法捕捉模型的真实认知状态。虽然最近基于机制的方怯利用隐藏状态动态，但它们通常聚合残差流更新，混淆了参数化记忆（前馈网络）和上下文处理（注意力）的不同作用。我们认为这种聚合掩盖了诸如记忆-上下文错配等细粒度机制冲突，而这些冲突是不确定性根本的指示器。为此，我们引入了\textbf{D}ecoupled \textbf{U}pdate \textbf{D}ynamics \textbf{(DUD)}框架，该框架通过噪声诱导的因果干预明确地将FFN和注意力贡献解耦。通过量化每个模块的独立恢复能力，我们构建了一个双流动态特征，捕捉了模型内部的脆弱性。大量实验表明，DUD在不确定性估计和校准方面均显著优于现有最佳基线，同时展现出优越的跨数据集泛化能力，验证了解耦动态作为模型忠实度稳健代理的有效性。

articles.title: Don't Let Me Ask for It: LLMs Show Deficiencies in Active Multi-Turn Information Acquisition for Abductive Inference
articles.abstract: Abductive reasoning requires forming hypotheses that explain observed evidence and revising them as new evidence becomes available. While large language models (LLMs) are often evaluated on whether they solve abductive reasoning tasks correctly, less is known about how they acquire evidence, update their hypotheses, and decide when to stop. We introduce Alien Abduction game, an interactive probe for studying these behaviours under different interaction modes. The modes vary in whether evidence is provided upfront or across turns, and whether queries are selected by the model or examples are provided by the oracle. Across models, providing evidence upfront leads to higher success rates than distributing it across turns. In multi-turn settings, some models commit before using the available evidence, while others exhaust the turn budget without converging. Models also achieve higher success rates when examples are provided by the oracle than when they select their own queries, although their final hypotheses are more consistent with the evidence they selected. These findings suggest that models may form hypotheses that fit self-selected evidence without sufficiently distinguishing them from alternatives, and may struggle to validate and refine their hypotheses or determine when to stop.
articles.titleCn: 不要让我去询问：在溯因推理中的主动多轮信息获取方面，大型语言模型显示出不足
articles.abstractCn: 溯因推理需要形成解释观察证据的假设，并在新证据出现时对其进行修正。虽然大型语言模型（LLMs）通常通过评估其解决溯因推理任务的正确性来衡量其能力，但人们对它们如何获取证据、更新假设以及何时停止了解较少。我们介绍了“外星溯因游戏”，这是一个交互式探针，用于在不同交互模式下研究这些行为。这些模式在证据是预先提供还是分回合提供，以及查询是由模型选择还是由神谕提供示例方面有所不同。在所有模型中，预先提供证据比分回合提供证据导致更高的成功率。在多回合设置中，一些模型在使用可用证据前就做出决定，而另一些模型则耗尽回合预算仍未收敛。当神谕提供示例时，模型的成功率也高于自行选择查询时，尽管它们的最终假设与所选证据更为一致。这些发现表明，模型可能会形成与自我选择的证据相匹配的假设，而未能充分区分它们与替代方案，并且可能在验证和修正假设或确定何时停止方面存在困难。

articles.title: FACTWASH: Catching AI Rewrites That Wash Hearsay into Fact
articles.abstract: AI systems rewrite information constantly: conversations become stored memories, documents become answers. The rewrite can keep a claim while washing away what made it checkable, who said it, how sure they were, when it held. We call that failure factwashing, and release factwash, an open-source write-time gate that catches it deterministically, with named flags and evidence rather than an LLM judge. Building it answers a practical question: when does a cheap check suffice, and when do you need a model? What decides is whether the property has a bounded surface-cue inventory. Explicit negation cues are close to enumerable, so a word list finishes and transfers, reaching 0.91 F1 on untuned text. Hedging and attribution have open-ended realizations, so vocabulary plateaus near half recall, and a one-question LLM witness recovers +17 and +15 points of cue-detection recall at equal precision. Deployed, that witness may only lower a verdict, so it buys precision rather than coverage. We measure cue detection on 105,596 independently annotated sentences. A blind-labelled corpus of memory writes then locates the failure: 55% of bad writes in conversational hearsay, 7% in business email (p < 0.001), so the first deployment question is not which detector to use but whether the failure occurs at all. On unmodified mem0 2.0.7, the gate flags 5 of 8 hedged-hearsay writes.
