articles.titleCn: 超越准确性：对大型语言模型统计推理的多维度评估
articles.abstractCn: 统计推理是多维度的，然而对大型语言模型（LLM）的评估通常侧重于响应的准确性，而忽略了模型如何构建和传达统计解释。本研究通过结合响应准确性、响应行为、结构主题建模和词汇相似度分析，展示了多维评估的价值。该框架应用于15款当前代际LLM生成的解释，这些解释是对从涵盖高中、本科和研究生水平的四门统计学考试中抽取的90个问题的回答。模型的准确性差异很大，范围从55%到78%。相比之下，结构主题建模揭示了所有模型在统计推理方面具有共同的概念组织，而词汇相似度分析则识别出解释风格中存在适度但一致的供应商特定差异。由同一供应商（例如Anthropic、OpenAI）开发的模型生成的解释比来自不同供应商的模型更为相似。这些发现表明，当代LLM中的统计推理不能仅由准确性来表征，并说明了如何通过补充分析响应行为和模型生成的解释，为生成式AI中的统计推理提供更全面的评估。

articles.title: Language Models Encode the Contextual Truth of Propositions
articles.abstract: Prior work has shown that LLMs encode the truth of factual propositions along linear directions in activation space. It's unclear how these representations extend to contextual truth: propositions whose truth is determined by in-context evidence rather than world knowledge. We show that LLMs maintain a linear representation of contextual truth that persists across structurally different output policies, even when the output doesn't require the model to determine a proposition's truth, and show causal evidence via steering experiments. Using the transcripts from a collaborative vision-language task that requires two LLMs to maintain a shared common ground, we show that truth representations of a proposition are significantly swayed by partner assertions about that proposition, even when the LLM has enough evidence to determine its truth. We find evidence that propositions near the decision boundary are more susceptible to having their truth shifted through partner assertions. Separating representation from output distinguish two forms of sycophancy that output behavior alone cannot: the model may accommodate a false proposition while continuing to represent it as false, or shift its representation across the boundary. The latter is 2.59x more common when the model agrees by restating the false claim explicitly than when it agrees implicitly.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型编码命题的情境真实性
articles.abstractCn: 先前研究表明，大型语言模型在激活空间中沿线性方向编码事实命题的真伪。但这些表征如何扩展到情境真伪——即其真伪由情境证据而非世界知识决定——尚不明确。我们证明，即使输出不需要模型判断命题真伪，大型语言模型仍保持情境真伪的线性表征，这种表征跨结构不同的输出策略持续存在，并通过转向实验提供了因果证据。使用需要两个大型语言模型维持共同基础的协作视觉语言任务的文本记录，我们表明，即使大型语言模型有足够证据判断命题真伪，其真伪表征仍会受到伙伴对该命题断言的显著影响。我们发现，决策边界附近的命题更易受伙伴断言影响而改变真伪。将表征与输出分离可区分输出行为单独无法识别的两种谄媚形式：模型可能在不改变表征的情况下容纳错误命题，或跨越边界改变其表征。当模型通过明确重述错误主张来达成一致时，后者比隐性同意时更常见，发生率高出2.59倍。

articles.title: On the Non-Specificity of Statistical Measures Used in Script Decipherment
articles.abstract: Statistical regularities are routinely offered as evidence that undeciphered sign systems encode language; the Indus script debate is the canonical example. Any such inference rests on specificity: the reported outcome must be unusual among plausible structured non-languages. We test that premise constructively with SIGIL, a purpose-built generative emblem system whose 3,000-text core corpus carries explicit compositional meanings although no sign has a phonological value. A literature registry compiled in advance of evaluation records 54 methods and admits a method to exact scoring when both the published Indus outcome and a source-defined decision rule can be reproduced. SIGIL receives the same category as the Indus corpus on every criterion scored this way, across repetition, directional-asymmetry, and lexical-distribution tests. Declared reconstructions of entropy, frequency, positional, predictive, classifier, and network measures reproduce the familiar Indus-like signatures as well. A sequential decipherment stress test then reaches high dictionary coverage for English, Sanskrit, and Tamil on the same corpus, while grouped held-out declines and unstable keys reveal how little that coverage identifies. The construction does not decide what the Indus signs encode: it shows that the evaluated measures detect organization without being specific to language, and therefore cannot, on their own, establish encoded speech.
articles.titleCn: 用于文本破译的统计指标的非特异性研究
articles.abstractCn: 统计规律通常被用作证明未破译的符号系统编码语言的证据；印度河流域文字的争论是典型的例子。任何此类推论都基于特异性：报告的结果必须在所有可能的非语言结构中显得不寻常。我们通过SIGIL——一个专门构建的生成性标志系统——以建设性的方式检验这一前提，该系统的3,000文本核心语料库虽然没有任何符号具有语音价值，但明确携带组合意义。在评估前预先编制的文献登记册记录了54种方法，并承认一种在可以重现已发表的印度河流域结果和源定义的决策规则时进行精确评分的方法。SIGIL在通过重复性、方向性不对称性和词汇分布测试等所有评分标准下，都获得与印度河流域语料库相同的类别。声明的熵、频率、位置、预测、分类器和网络度量值的重建也重现了熟悉的类似印度河流域的签名。随后的顺序破译压力测试在同一语料库上对英语、梵语和泰米尔语实现了高词汇覆盖率，而分组保留下降和不可靠的密钥揭示了覆盖率识别了多少不足。这种构建并不能决定印度河流域符号编码的内容：它表明评估的度量可以检测组织性而不特指语言，因此不能单独证明编码的言语。

articles.title: AcceptMoE: Commitment-Weighted Self-Sizing Verifier Expert Sets for Efficient MoE Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Speculative decoding verifies a tree of draft tokens in one target-model forward pass. For a mixture-of-experts (MoE) target, however, parallel verification can activate the union of the experts selected by all tree nodes, even though only a small subset of those nodes reaches the accepted output. Token count, activated-expert union size, and expert-weight traffic are therefore distinct cost measures: reducing the token workload need not shrink the expert union proportionally, and under offloading, transfer traffic also depends on cache residency. We introduce AcceptMoE, a verifier-side expert selector that combines target-router scores with offline-estimated commitment probabilities and automatically adjusts the number of eligible experts for each verification block, eliminating the need for a user-specified expert budget. Under offloading, AcceptMoE conditions expert eligibility on cache residency instead of predicting natural routes and prefetching the corresponding expert weights. Although constraining target-expert eligibility changes the model distribution, across 12 model-task pairs spanning three MoE targets and four benchmarks, AcceptMoE's mean accuracy is 0.27 percentage points lower than that of EAGLE-3 speculative decoding with natural routing. Served with SGLang at batch size one, it reaches 1.290 times the throughput of this baseline with all expert weights in GPU memory, and 2.06 times under physical expert offloading, while reducing host-to-device traffic by 73.6 percent to 77.1 percent.
articles.titleCn: AcceptMoE：基于承诺权重自适应调整验证器专家集的高效MoE推测解码
articles.abstractCn: 推测解码在单个目标模型前向传递中验证草稿标记树。然而，对于混合专家（MoE）目标，并行验证可能激活所有树节点所选专家的并集，即使只有一小部分节点达到接受输出。因此，标记计数、激活专家并集大小和专家权重流量是不同的成本指标：减少标记工作负载不必按比例缩小专家并集，在卸载情况下，传输流量也取决于缓存驻留。我们引入了AcceptMoE，这是一种结合目标路由器分数和离线估计的承诺概率的验证端专家选择器，它可以自动调整每个验证块的合格专家数量，从而无需用户指定的专家预算。在卸载情况下，AcceptMoE根据缓存驻留条件专家资格，而不是预测自然路由并预取相应的专家权重。尽管限制目标-专家资格会改变模型分布，但在跨越三个MoE目标和四个基准的12个模型任务对中，AcceptMoE的平均准确率比具有自然路由的EAGLE-3推测解码低0.27个百分点。使用SGLang以单批次大小服务时，它达到所有专家权重在GPU内存中的基线吞吐量的1.290倍，在物理专家卸载情况下达到2.06倍，同时将主机到设备的流量减少了73.6%至77.1%。

articles.title: Temporal Leakage in LLM Backtesting: Measurement, Validation, and Adjusted Scores
articles.abstract: The standard check for contamination in LLM backtests is simple: compare scores before and after the training cutoff. We show this check is uninformative. Four flagship models fail it on questions they cannot have memorized: every scored question resolved after their cutoffs. The reason is structural. Models legitimately know more about times near their cutoff, so recency mimics leakage, and we prove no passive backtest can separate the two from genuine skill. Measurement, not just detection, requires information from outside the backtest. We supply it in two forms. A known cutoff identifies leakage at the boundary; a matched clean control identifies it globally and yields a leakage-adjusted score. We also derive where leakage hides: it concentrates on outcomes that surprised the crowd and were well covered in training, and partial memorization is disproportionately rewarded. We validate the estimators against ground truth by planting leakage in twin models, where they recover the injected dose and return null on clean questions. Deployed on frontier models, they detect one cutoff-localized signature and, at the audit's power floor, clear five models whose apparent advantages were recency alone. Backtests need not be discarded; they need one defensible reference.

articles.titleCn: LLM回测中的时间泄露：测量、验证和调整分数
articles.abstractCn: LLM回测中检测污染的标准方法是简单比较训练截止点前后的得分。我们证明这种检测方法是无信息的。四个旗舰模型在它们无法记住的问题上均未通过该检测：所有得分问题都在它们的截止点之后得到解决。原因在于结构性问题。模型在截止点附近确实知道更多内容，因此近期效应模拟了数据泄露，并且我们证明没有被动回测能从真实能力中区分这两者。测量，而不仅仅是检测，需要回测之外的额外信息。我们以两种形式提供这种信息。一个已知的截止点可以识别边界处的泄露；一个匹配的干净对照可以全局识别泄露，并给出校正泄露后的得分。我们还推导出泄露隐藏的位置：它集中在那些让群体感到惊讶且在训练中覆盖良好的结果上，并且部分记忆被不成比例地奖励。我们通过在孪生模型中植入泄露来验证这些估计器，其中它们恢复了注入的剂量，并在干净问题上返回了零值。在前沿模型上部署它们，它们检测到一个截止点局部特征，并且在审计的效力底线清除了五个仅凭近期效应而显得具有优势的模型。回测不必被废弃；它们只需要一个有说服力的参考依据。

articles.title: TQLite: Multi-LLM Jury Guided Distillation for Real-time MQM Translation Quality Evaluation
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in MQM-based translation quality (TQ) evaluation, and recent advances in large reasoning models (LRMs) promise even greater improvements. However, both LLMs and LRMs are computationally expensive to deploy at scale, while small language models (SLMs)---though much more efficient---struggle with the complex reasoning required for evaluation tasks. In this work, we present an extensive empirical study benchmarking SLMs, LLMs, and LRMs across a wide range of TQ evaluation setups, providing a comprehensive view of the current landscape and establishing best practices. To address the scalability challenge, we introduce TQLite, a novel distillation framework that enables SLMs to approach the MQM evaluation performance of the best LRM-based evaluators. Our approach leverages a multi-LRM jury to generate high-quality synthetic training data via practical data curation techniques and aggregation of evaluation responses across a diverse panel of models. Our results demonstrate that SLMs trained via TQLite achieve strong MQM evaluation performance that far exceeds off-the-shelf evaluation capabilities of standard SLMs, offering a scalable and cost-effective alternative to LLM- and LRM-based evaluators.
articles.titleCn: TQLite：多LLM陪审团指导蒸馏用于实时MQM翻译质量评估
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在基于MQM的翻译质量（TQ）评估中展现了令人印象深刻的性能，而大型推理模型（LRMs）的最新进展则预示着更进一步的提升。然而，无论是LLMs还是LRMs，在规模化部署时都面临高昂的计算成本，而小型语言模型（SLMs）——尽管效率更高——在评估任务所需的复杂推理方面仍存在挑战。在本工作中，我们通过在广泛的TQ评估设置中对SLMs、LLMs和LRMs进行基准测试，进行了一项广泛的实证研究，全面展现了当前的技术格局并确立了最佳实践。为应对可扩展性挑战，我们引入了TQLite，这是一个新颖的蒸馏框架，使SLMs能够接近最佳LRM评估器的MQM评估性能。我们的方法利用多LRM陪审团，通过实用的数据管理技术和跨多样化模型评估响应的聚合，生成高质量的合成训练数据。我们的结果表明，通过TQLite训练的SLMs在MQM评估中取得了优异的性能，远超标准SLMs的现成评估能力，为LLM和LRM评估器提供了一种可扩展且成本效益高的替代方案。

articles.title: Mapping the City Through the Lens of Language Models
articles.abstract: Language models often complete an underspecified reference to a city with unstated assumptions about urban size, form, infrastructure, environment, and function. We measure those assumptions without naming places. Ten open-weight checkpoints rate anonymized profiles derived from real morphological urban centres across 40 audited indicators and seven domains. The design combines constrained probability-based ratings, prespecified reliability screens, lineage-aware aggregation, multiple population weightings, an independent replication sample, and whole-profile validation. The clearest shared tendency favours urban profiles with larger developed area, faster recent growth, greater mapped infrastructure and non-residential capacity, and less sparse form. Most eligible directions recur in the replication data, and direct ratings of complete profiles show moderate agreement with the indicator-wise construction. Geographic differences shrink after accounting for city scale and development, while reliably measured paired tasks indicate that typicality and desirability are often closely aligned. The framework makes an otherwise vague notion of what models regard as an ordinary city empirically traceable. The resulting evidence delineates a shared yet model-dependent portrait of the city through the lens of language models.
articles.titleCn: 通过语言模型映射城市
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型通常在完成对城市的不明确指称时，基于未言明的假设来推断城市规模、形态、基础设施、环境和功能。我们在不提及具体地名的情况下衡量这些假设。十个开放权重检查点对从40个经过审核的指标和七个领域推导出的真实形态城市中心的匿名化资料进行评分。该设计结合了受约束的概率评分、预定义的可靠性筛选、谱系感知聚合、多重人口权重、独立复制样本和整体资料验证。最明显的共同趋势倾向于具有较大建成区、较快的近期增长、更多已绘制的基础设施和非住宅容量以及更紧凑形态的城市资料。大多数符合条件的方向在复制数据中重现，而完整资料的直接评分与逐指标构建显示出中等程度的一致性。在考虑城市规模和发展因素后，地理差异会缩小，而可靠测量的配对任务表明典型性与可接受性通常高度一致。该框架使模型认为的普通城市这一模糊概念变得可实证追踪。由此产生的证据通过语言模型的视角描绘了一幅共享但模型相关的城市图景。
